n-m-h1-ineq-03.title: Ngaba "Ukuba a<b, ngoko 1/a > 1/b" Ihlala Iyinyani? Ukwakha Imizekelo Echasayo
n-m-h1-ineq-03.goal: Yakha imizekelo echasayo ngokwakho ukuhlola nini isibakala esiqukumbela ipropati yokungalingani siyinyani, uze ufumane imeko apho isibakala sisebenza khona.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.material: U-Mina uthe, "Ukuba a<b, ngoko 1/a > 1/b. Ukuba 2<5, ngoko 1/2 > 1/5, kwaye ukuba 3<7, ngoko 1/3 > 1/7. Ndihlole ezininzi, kwaye zonke zichanekile." (a no-b ngamanani angengo-0.)
n-m-h1-ineq-03.thinking.0: Ukwahlula imizekelo ehambelana nesibakala kunaleyo iphikisana naso
n-m-h1-ineq-03.thinking.1: Ukufumana oko imizekelo echasayo ifana ngako
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.prompt: Yenza imizekelo ebonisa ukuba isibakala sika-Mina siphosisile. Ngenisa iibini ezintathu ezahlukeneyo zamanani aphelele angengo-0 a, b ukuze a<b kodwa 1/a > 1/b ingasebenzi. (Ixabiso elipheleleyo li-50 ubuninzi)
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.hint.0: Linga iibini ezininzi ngokwakho. Tshintsha iimpawu zika-a no-b, ubale 1/a no-1/b, uze uthelekise ubungakanani bazo.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga ukuba ipropati enjani yonke imizekelo eyihloliweyo ngu-Mina ebelana ngayo, ufumane iibini ezingenayo ipropati leyo.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.fail.c1: a no-b kufuneka babe ngamanani angengo-0.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.fail.c3: Sebenzisa amanani aphelele anexabiso elipheleleyo elingu-50 ubuninzi.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.fail.c5: Kule bini, 1/a > 1/b isasebenza, ngoko akungumzekelo ochasayo.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.explain: Ukuba a=−2 no-b=5, ngoko 1/a=−1/2 kunye no-1/b=1/5, ngoko 1/a < 1/b. Kuyo yonke imizekelo echasayo, a yayithabatha no-b yayibonakalisa ngokongeza.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.prompt: Khetha imeko echanekileyo apho 1/a > 1/b kufuneka isebenze xa a<b kwaye a, b bengengo-0.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.hint.0: Thelekisa macala ngamacala iimpawu zika-a no-b kwimizekelo echasayo oyenze kwinyathelo elidlulileyo nakwimizekelo ehloliweyo ngu-Mina.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kwinketho nganye, yenza ibini lamanani elihambelana nayo uthelekise 1/a no-1/b.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.o.a: Ubuncinane enye ka-a no-b ibonakalisa ngokongeza
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.r.a: Nokuba enye ibonakalisa ngokongeza, njengoko a=−2, b=5, isibakala siyaphosisa.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.r.b: Ukuba b=5 no-a=−2, ngumzekelo ochasayo. Ukuba b ibonakalisa ngokongeza akwanelanga.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.r.c: Kukho umzekelo ochasayo onamanani aphelele (−2, 5). Ingxaki luphawu, hayi uhlobo lwenani.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.explain: 1/a − 1/b = (b−a)/(ab) kwaye b−a>0, ngoko ukuba ab>0 ibonakalisa ngokongeza kwaye 1/a>1/b. Ukuba ab<0 ithabatha kwaye isibakala siyaphosisa.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.prompt: Bhala 1/a − 1/b njengeqhezu elinye, uze usebenzise oko kumisela uphawu lwalo ukuchaza ukuba kutheni impendulo yenyathelo 2 ichanekile.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.hint.0: Fumana inani elingaphantsi eliqhelekileyo ubhale 1/a − 1/b njengeqhezu elinye.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.hint.1: Dibanisa oko iimpawu zenani elingasentla nelingaphantsi ngalinye lixhomekeke kuko nemeko a<b.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba usebenzise into yokuba inani elingasentla lihlala libonakalisa ngokongeza?
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uqukumbele ukuba isiphumo sixhomekeke kuphawu luka-ab?
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.model.0: 1/a − 1/b = (b−a)/(ab). Kuba a<b, b−a ibonakalisa ngokongeza, ngoko uphawu lumiselwa ngu-ab. Ukuba ab>0, ngoko 1/a>1/b, kwaye ukuba ab<0, ngoko 1/a<1/b.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.model.1: Ukudibanisa kunika (b−a)/(ab). Inani elingasentla b−a libonakalisa ngokongeza, ngoko 1/a − 1/b > 0 kuphela xa ab ibonakalisa ngokongeza, oko kukuthi, xa a no-b banophawu olufanayo.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.model.2: Inani elingasentla b−a libonakalisa ngokongeza kuba a<b. Ngoko isiphumo sixhomekeke ekubeni imveliso ka-a no-b ibonakalisa ngokongeza okanye ithabatha.

n-m-h1-comb-05.title: Kufuneka wazi ntoni ukugqiba ukuba zikho iindlela ezingaphi zokwabela amabhola ezibhokisini?
n-m-h1-comb-05.topic: Ukubala: ukugqiba ukuba kufuneka kwahlulwe ntoni engxakini
n-m-h1-comb-05.goal: Kwingxaki yokubala, chonga ulwazi olugqiba ukuba iziphumo ezifanayo zithathwa njengenye (ingaba izinto ziyahlulwa, ingaba iibhokisi ezingenanto ziyavunyelwa), uze uqinisekise ukuba inani litshintsha ngolo lwazi.
n-m-h1-comb-05.material: UMina ubuza, "Zikho iindlela ezingaphi zokwabela amabhola ama-3 kwiibhokisi ezi-2?", kwaye abahlobo bakhe banika iimpendulo ezahlukileyo. Oku kungenxa yokuba ingxaki ilahlekelwa lulwazi oluthile.
n-m-h1-comb-05.thinking.0: Chonga ulwazi olufunekayo ukuze kumiselwe impendulo enye
n-m-h1-comb-05.thinking.1: Yazi ukuba inani litshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kumgangatho wokuthatha izinto njengezifanayo
n-m-h1-comb-05.thinking.2: Chaza indlela inani litshintsha ngayo xa imeko itshintsha
n-m-h1-comb-05.prereq.0: Ukubhala iimeko ngoyilo lomthi okanye itheyibhile
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izinto ekufuneka uzazi ukumisela impendulo enye kule ngxaki.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.hint.0: Thelekisa ukuba bangaphi iziphumo ezahlukileyo ulungiselelo "amabhola ama-3 kwibhokisi enye, angu-0 kwenye" elubonakala ngalo xa iibhokisi ziyahlulwa nalapho zingahlulwa.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tshintsha iinxalenye zolwazi enye ngexesha, hlola ukuba inani ofumana ngokubala ngqo liyatshintsha na, uze ufumane ukuba loluphi ulwazi olungalutshintshi.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.o.a: Ingaba iibhokisi ezimbini ziyahlulwa komnye komnye (ingaba iibhokisi zinamanani)
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.r.b: Isixhobo asichaphazeli inani. Ukuba izinto ziyahlulwa lulwazi olutshintsha inani.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.o.c: Ingaba amabhola ama-3 ayahlulwa komnye komnye (ingaba aneemibala eyahlukileyo)
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.o.d: Ingaba ibhokisi ivunyelwe ukuba ingabi nanto
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.r.e: Ukuba umbala ongaphakathi webhokisi usebenza njengendlela yokuzahlula sele ugutyungelwe kukuba iibhokisi ziyahlulwa. Olu lwazi lodwa alunakugqiba inani.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.explain: Izinto ezintathu kufuneka zimiselwe. Ukuba iibhokisi namabhola ayahlulwa kugqiba ukuba iziphumo zemo efanayo zithathwa njengenye okanye ezimbini, kwaye ukuba iibhokisi ezingenanto ziyavunyelwa kutshintsha abagqatswa ngokwabo. Isixhobo nombala ongaphakathi azichaphazeli inani.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.prompt: Amabhola ama-3 onke abonakala efana, iibhokisi ezi-2 zinamanani ahlukileyo ngoko ziyahlulwa, kwaye iibhokisi ezingenanto ziyavunyelwa. Zikho iindlela ezingaphi?
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.hint.0: Nyusa inani lamabhola kwibhokisi 1 ukusuka kwi-0 enye ngenye, uze ubhale kwitheyibhile ukuba mangaphi aya kwibhokisi 2.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuba ekubeni onke amabhola efana, ulungiselelo apho ibhokisi iphethe inani elifanayo lamabhola lubalwa njengolunye.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.r.a: Eli linani xa iibhokisi zingahlulwa. Ngeebhokisi ezinamanani ahlukileyo, (3, 0) kunye ne-(0, 3) ziziphumo ezahlukileyo.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.r.b: Oku kubala kuphela iimeko ezinamabhola e-1, 2, okanye ama-3 kwibhokisi 1. Imeko enamabhola angu-0 kwibhokisi 1 ilahlekile.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.r.d: Eli linani xa amabhola ahlulwa. Amabhola kule ngxaki onke ayafana.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.explain: Ukwahlula kwiimeko apho ibhokisi 1 inamabhola angu-0, 1, 2, 3, aseleyo aya kwibhokisi 2, ngoko zikho iindlela ezi-4. (Umzekelo, u-0 kwibhokisi 1 uthetha ama-3 kwibhokisi 2, kwaye ama-3 kwibhokisi 1 athetha u-0 kwibhokisi 2, eziziphumo ezahlukileyo.)
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba amabhola ama-3 aneemibala eyahlukileyo kwaye ayahlulwa (iibhokisi zisahlulwa kwaye iibhokisi ezingenanto ziyavunyelwa), zikho iindlela ezingaphi? Chaza nendlela oku okunxulumene ngayo neendlela ezi-4 zangaphambili.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.hint.0: Nika amabhola amagama (obomvu, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ophuzi) ubhale, enye emva kwenye, isigqibo sokuba ibhola nganye iya kweyiphi ibhokisi.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.hint.1: Phakathi kweendlela ezi-4 zangaphambili, bhala ulungiselelo (ama-2 kwibhokisi 1, e-1 kwibhokisi 2) usebenzisa amabhola anamagama, uze ubale ukuba zikho iindlela ezingaphi.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Xa amabhola ahlulwa, ingaba ubhale ukuba ibhola e-1 inokuya kwiibhokisi ezingaphi?
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ufumene ukuba isiphumo esinjenge-(2, 1) esiphuma kwiindlela ezi-4 zangaphambili sihlulwa saba zindlela ezingaphi xa amabhola ahlulwa?
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba amabhola ayahlulwa, ibhola nganye inazo iibhokisi ezi-2 zokuya kuzo, kwaye amabhola ama-3 anqunyelwa enye emva kwenye, ngoko 2×2×2=8 iindlela. Ngamabhola afanayo, (3, 0) yindlela e-1, kodwa xa amabhola ahlulwa, (2, 1) ihlulwa ibe ziindlela ezi-3, ngoko 1+3+3+1=8.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.model.1: Ibhola nganye inokhetho olubini, ibhokisi 1 okanye ibhokisi 2, ngoko 2^3=8 iindlela. Iindlela ezi-4 zamabhola afanayo zihlulwa zibe ziindlela ezi-1, 3, 3, 1 xa amabhola ahlulwa, kwaye ezi zongeza zibe ngu-8.

n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.r.d: Kwi-n=4, 6, 8, O−E yi-2, 3, 4, eyona ikhulayo ngokwenene. Awunakuthi ngemizekelo embalwa kwenzeka ntoni emva kokuba n ibe nkulu.

O−E=k²−k(k−1)=k, yaye kuba k linani lemvelo ihlala iphozithivu, ngoko kukho izixa ezingaphelelanga ezininzi.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.model.1: O ziindlela ezingu-k×k=k², ukhetha elinye kwamanani angaphelelanga angama-k nelinye kwamanani aphelele angama-k. E ziindlela ezingu-k(k−1), isixa seendlela ezingu-k(k−1)/2 zokukhetha amabini angaphelelanga kunye neendlela ezingu-k(k−1)/2 zokukhetha amabini aphelele. Umahluko O−E=k>0, ngoko kukho izixa ezingaphelelanga ezingu-k ngaphezulu.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.model.2: O ziindlela ezingu-k×k=k², ukhetha elinye kwamanani angaphelelanga angama-k nelinye kwamanani aphelele angama-k, yaye E ziindlela ezingu-k(k−1). Ngoko O ihlala inkulu kune-E nge-k.

n-m-h1-geo-02.title: Ngowuphi Ulwazi Onokumisela Isangqa Esinye?

n-m-h1-geo-02.material: UYuna uthi uzobe isangqa esinye kwiplani yeekhowudinethi, yaye ufuna ukuxelela umhlobo wakhe iimeko ukuze lo mhlobo azobe kanye lo sangqa. Phakathi kweeseti zeemeko ezingezantsi, ufuna ukukhetha ezo zivumela umhlobo wakhe ukuba azobe esinye isangqa ngokucacileyo. (Isangqa sisimo esinesiko elinye nerediyasi eyipositivu.)

Kwi-a, amachaphaza amathathu akumgca omnye, ngoko akukho sangqa sidlula kuwo; kwi-b, u-x=3 sele ungumgca ohlula phakathi ime nkqo omiselwe ngamachaphaza amabini, ngoko asiloluwazi lutsha yaye kukho izangqa ezingenasiphelo. Kwi-e, iziko lingaba (3,4) okanye (3,−4).

n-m-h1-geo-09.title: Umgama Omfutshane Kakhulu Ukusuka Kwichaphaza Ukuya Kwicandelo Lomgca
n-m-h1-geo-09.goal: Yakha imizekelo apho ukusebenzisa ifomula yomgama wesichaphaza-kumgca ngqo kwicandelo lomgca kunika impendulo ephosakeleyo, uze uchaze umthetho wezo meko.
n-m-h1-geo-09.material: Kwiplani yekhowudinethi kukho icandelo lomgca u-AB elidibanisa amachaphaza amabini A(0,0) no-B(4,3). Umgca u-AB (hayi icandelo) yi-3x−4y=0. (Funda √13 njenge-"ingcambu ye-13" kwaye √50 njenge-"ingcambu ye-50.")
n-m-h1-geo-09.thinking.0: Ukuhlola uluhlu apho ifomula isebenza khona
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.prompt: Ungumgama muni omfutshane kakhulu ukusuka kwichaphaza P(7,1) ukuya kwichaphaza elikwicandelo lomgca u-AB?
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuba isiseko sethe nkqo ukusuka ku-P ukuya kumgca u-AB silele ngaphakathi kwicandelo lomgca u-AB.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana zombini umgama ukuya kumgca nemigama ukuya kwiziphelo ezimbini, uze uzithelekise.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.r.b: Eli lixabiso elivela kwifomula yomgama wesichaphaza-kumgca. Eli xabiso ngumgama ukuya kumgca u-AB, kwaye alinakuthiwa lilingana nomgama ukuya kwicandelo lomgca.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.r.c: Lo ngumgama ukuya esiphelweni u-A. Hlola ukuba ukhethe esona sisondele phakathi kwezi ziphelo zimbini.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.r.d: Kubonakala ngathi uthathe umahluko wekhowudinethi ye-x njengomgama.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.explain: Umgama ukuya kumgca u-AB yi-|21−4|/5=17/5, kodwa isiseko sethe nkqo ukusuka ku-P ukuya kumgca silele ngaphandle kwecandelo lomgca (ngaphaya kuka-B). Ngoko ichaphaza elisondele kakhulu kwicandelo lomgca sisiphelo u-B, ngomgama o-√(9+4)=√13≈3.61. Oku kukhulu kune-17/5=3.4.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amachaphaza ama-3 P(a,b). Kufuneka abe ngamachaphaza anamakhowudinethi apheleleyo apho umgama ukusuka ku-P ukuya kumgca u-AB uhluke kumgama omfutshane kakhulu ukuya kwicandelo lomgca u-AB.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s2.hint.0: Usebenzisa umfanekiso, cinga ukuba u-P kufuneka abe kweliphi icala ukuze isiseko sethe nkqo ukusuka ku-P ukuya kumgca siwele ngaphandle kwecandelo lomgca.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s2.hint.1: Jonga unxulumano lwekhowudinethi kumzekelo osele uwazi, njenge-(7,1), ufumane amachaphaza afanayo.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s2.ok.k2: Isiseko sethe nkqo siphandle kwecandelo lomgca u-AB.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s2.fail.k2: Kweli chaphaza, isiseko sethe nkqo singaphakathi kwecandelo lomgca u-AB (okanye esiphelweni), ngoko imigama emibini iyalingana.

n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s3.prompt: Ngokwamachaphaza owenzileyo, bhala umthetho owahlula xa unokusebenzisa ifomula yomgama wesichaphaza-kumgca ngqo ukufumana umgama omfutshane kakhulu ukusuka kwichaphaza ukuya kwicandelo lomgca nalapho ungenako. Kwiimeko apho ungenako, bhala nendlela yokuyifumana.

n-m-h1-geo-05.title: Umgca Odlula Kwindawo Esemgama Ongatshintshiyo Ukusuka Kwimvelaphi

n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s1.hint.1: Faka i-c kwifomyula yomgama ukuze ufumane ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-a ne-b, uze ukhethe amaxabiso amanani aphelele.

n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.prompt: Ngeli xesha, tshintsha umgama ukusuka kwimvelaphi ube yi-5. Zingaphi imigca edlula kwindawo (5,0) kwaye isemgama we-5 ukusuka kwimvelaphi?
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ufumane umgama ukusuka kwindawo (5,0) ukuya kwimvelaphi.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ukuba umgama phakathi kwemvelaphi nomgca odlula kwindawo (5,0) ungaba mkhulu kunalo xabiso na.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.r.a: Kubonakala ngathi ubone ukulingana kuphikisana ngexesha lokusombulula ngethambeka njenge-y=m(x−5), waza waqukumbela ukuba akukho mgca.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.r.c: Kubonakala ngathi uthwale inani lomgama we-3. Xa umgama utshintsha, inani nalo linokutshintsha.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.r.d: Kukho imigca emininzi edlula kwindawo, kodwa umqathango womgama uthintela icala.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s2.explain: Umgama ukusuka kwindawo (5,0) ukuya kwimvelaphi ungu-5. Phakathi kwemigca edlula kule ndawo, olona luhambele kude kakhulu kwimvelaphi ngumgca omnye u-x=5, ime nkqo kwisiqephu esidibanisa imvelaphi ne-(5,0), kwaye sesona msela kuphela osemgama we-5.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba umisela umgca njenge-y=m(x−5) uze usombulule umqathango womgama, uphosa umgca wengxaki yangaphambili (imeko yomgama we-5). Chaza ukuba ngumgca onjani ophoswayo nesizathu.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.hint.0: Cinga ukuba kukho umgca ongenakuveliswa ngu-y=m(x−5) ngokungakhathaliseki ukuba i-m linani elingakanani.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.hint.1: Fumana ngqo umgama phakathi kwemvelaphi nomgca onjalo.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uchaze ukuba ngowuphi umgca ongenakubhalwa ngohlobo lwe-y=m(x−5)?
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uchaze ukuba kutheni uhlobo olubanzi ax+by+c=0 lunokumela nalo mgca?
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uqhagamshele oku nesizathu sokuba inani lemigca lahluke kumgama we-3 nowe-5?
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.model.0: Umgca ophoswayo ngu-x=5. Umgca othe nkqo, ohambelana ne-y-eksisi, awunayo ithambeka, ngoko awunakubhalwa ngohlobo lwe-y=m(x−5). Kodwa umgama ukusuka kwimvelaphi ukuya ku-x=5 ungu-5, ngoko kanye ngumgca owanelisa umqathango.
n-m-h1-geo-05.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba uyibhala ngethambeka m, umgca othe nkqo u-x=5 uyashiywa kuba ithambeka lawo alichazwanga. Lo mgca usemgama we-5 ukusuka kwimvelaphi kwaye udlula kwi-(5,0), ngoko ngempendulo, kwaye unokubhalwa ngohlobo lwe-ax+by+c=0 (a=1, b=0, c=−5).

n-m-h1-comb-09.title: Ukwahlula iimeko ezinika n(n−1) nokukhetha isisombululo solinganiso
n-m-h1-comb-09.topic: Ukubala: ukufumana n ngolinganiso nobubanzi besisombululo
n-m-h1-comb-09.goal: Hlula iimeko ezinolandelelwano (icala) nezingenalo ukwahlula n(n−1) kwi-n(n−1)/2, kwaye kwimeko oyenzayo, sombulula ulinganiso uze ukhethe isisombululo usebenzisa umqathango wokuba isisombululo kufuneka sibe linani lemvelo.
n-m-h1-comb-09.material: Cinga ngeemeko ezininzi ezibala ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu abahlukeneyo abangama-n (n linani lemvelo elingaphantsi kwe-2 okanye elilingana nalo). Ezinye zibalwa njenge-n(n−1) yaye ezinye njenge-n(n−1)/2.
n-m-h1-comb-09.thinking.2: Jonga ukuba isisombululo solinganiso sihambelana nemeko
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke iimeko ezingezantsi apho inani lonke leendlela libalwa njenge-n(n−1).
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.hint.0: Kwimeko nganye, kubantu ababini abafanayo A no-B, jonga ukuba (A, B) no-(B, A) ziziphumo ezahlukeneyo na.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.hint.1: Khumbula ukuba xa kukho ulandelelwano, uphindaphinda inani leendlela zokukhetha owokuqala kubantu abangama-n ngenani leendlela zokukhetha owesibini.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.o.a: Khetha umongameli o-1 nosekela-mongameli o-1 kubantu abangama-n.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.o.b: Bonke abantu abangama-n bayabambana ngezandla kanye.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.r.b: Ukubambana ngezandla kwenziwa ngabantu ababini bebonke, ngoko (A, B) no-(B, A) kukubambana ngezandla okufanayo. Ukukubala kabini kuthetha ukuba kufuneka wahlule nge-2.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.o.c: Khetha abafundi abangabasebenzi bokucoca aba-2 kubantu abangama-n.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.r.c: Abafundi abangabasebenzi bokucoca banendima efanayo, ngoko (A, B) no-(B, A) sisiphumo esifanayo.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.o.d: Umntu ngamnye kubantu abangama-n uthumela umyalezo omnye wesicatshulwa kumntu ngamnye omnye.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.o.e: Dibanisa isibini ngasinye phakathi kweedolophu ezingama-n ngendlela enye nganye.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.r.e: Indlela edibanisa iidolophu A no-B yindlela enye kwaye ayinalo icala. (A, B) no-(B, A) yindlela efanayo.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s1.explain: Kumongameli nosekela-mongameli, nakubantu ababini abafanayo, iindima ziyahluka, ngoko yi-n(n−1). Ukuthumela umyalezo wesicatshulwa nako kuyahluka xa u-A ethumela ku-B nxa u-B ethumela ku-A, ngoko yi-n(n−1). Ezinye azinalandelelwano okanye icala, ngoko ukubala kabini kuthetha ukwahlula nge-2, kunika n(n−1)/2.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.prompt: Yila imeko yakho apho izinto ezimbini zikhethwa ngaphandle kokwahlula ulandelelwano (icala), yenze inani lonke leendlela libe ngama-45. Misa uze usombulule ulinganiso lwe-n, uze ubhale nokuba kutheni esinye sezisombululo zolinganiso kufuneka silahlwe.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.hint.0: Nquma imeko yokukhetha abantu ababini, uze ujonge ukuba ukutshintshiselana abantu ababini abafanayo kunika isiphumo esifanayo.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.hint.1: Phinda ulungiselele ulinganiso lube lukhwadratikhi, ufumane zombini izisombululo, uze ufunde isisombululo ngasinye ngamagama emeko (inani labantu, njalo njalo).
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.placeholder: Umzekelo: Ndenze imeko apho ... Ulinganiso yi-... Izisombululo zi-..., ngoko ...
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Kwimeko oyenzileyo, ngaba ujonge ukuba ulandelelwano okanye icala alifuneki ngokwenene?
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba umise ulinganiso waza wafumana zombini izisombululo?
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uthethe ukuba kutheni isisombululo esilahlweyo singenakwenzeka kule meko?
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.model.0: Imeko yile yokuba bonke abantu abangama-n eklasini yethu bayabambana ngezandla kanye. Ukubambana ngezandla akunalandelelwano, ngoko n(n−1)/2=45, n²−n−90=0, (n−10)(n+9)=0, ngoko n=10 okanye −9. Inani labantu alinakuba negethivu, ngoko silahla u-−9 yaye n=10 abantu.
n-m-h1-comb-09.s.s2.model.1: Amaqela angama-n adlala omnye komnye kanye kwiligi, yimidlalo engama-45 zizonke. Umdlalo awunalo icala, ngoko nC2=45 kwaye n(n-1)=90. n=10 okanye n=-9, kodwa inani lamaqela kufuneka libe linani lemvelo, ngoko i--9 enegethivu ayivumelekanga yaye ngamaqela ali-10.

n-m-h1-func-04.thinking.0: Phinda uhlole isigqibo sakho njengoko ulwazi lukhula
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa ngecandelo elinye ngexesha. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha isigqibo usebenzisa kuphela oko usele ukwaziyo.
n-m-h1-func-04.topic: Imisebenzi neegrafu: imisebenzi edityanisiweyo nephambeneyo, imisebenzi eyiqhezu nengekho ngqiqweni, imida yomda
n-m-h1-func-04.title: Umsebenzi oyiqhezu onokuncitshiswa, nomgca: iindawo zokunqumlana zitshintsha njani?
n-m-h1-func-04.goal: Qinisekisa, ngelixa uhlaziya isigqibo sakho njengoko ulwazi luvezwa ngenye ngexesha, ukuba ukuncitshiswa kwebinzana eliyiqhezu kuyenza libonakale njengomgca kodwa imeko yomda isahleli.
n-m-h1-func-04.material: Sifuna ukufumana inani leendawo zokunqumlana zegrafu yomsebenzi f(x)=(x²−4)/(x−2) nemigca.
n-m-h1-func-04.prereq.1: Amaxabiso enza inani elingaphantsi libe ngu-0, nomda
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ngalo lonke ixesha ulwazi olutsha luvela, hlola ukuba isigqibo sakho ngokwangoku siyaphikisana nalo na.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.hint.1: Faka ixabiso le-x elifunyenwe kwibinzana elincitshisiweyo kwinani elingaphantsi lebinzana lokuqala uhlole ukuba liba ngu-0 na.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.info: f(x)=(x²−4)/(x−2), kwaye inani elingasentla lahlulwa ngezibalo njenge-(x−2)(x+2).
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Umgca othe tye y=k udibana negrafu ye-f kumachaphaza amangaphi, ngokuxhomekeke ku-k?
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Emva kokuncitshiswa, ithatha ifom ye-x+2, ngoko ibonakala ngathi idibana nomgca ngamnye othe tye kwindawo enye. Kodwa ukuncitshiswa kuvunyelwe kuphela xa x≠2. Kulwazi olulandelayo sihlola ukuba le meko itshintsha na isiphumo.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Idibana kwindawo enye kanye kuyo yonke k
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ugwebe ngebinzana elincitshisiweyo kuphela. Esi sigqibo esingekahloli umda.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uthandabuza ukuba kusenokubakho imeko eyashiywa xa kuncitshiswa.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Libinzana lequadratiki, ngoko lidibana kumachaphaza amabini kuyo yonke k
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ujonge kuphela into yokuba inani elingasentla liyiqwadratiki. Jonga inani elingaphantsi nokuncitshiswa kunye.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Ukufaka x=2 kwenza inani elingaphantsi libe ngu-0, ngoko f(2) ayichazwanga. Igrafu ayinalo ichaphaza elinex=2.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngoko lixabiso lini lika-k elenza umgca othe tye y=k ongadibaniyo nayo?
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Kwibinzana elincitshisiweyo y=x+2, xa x=2, y=4, ngoko ichaphaza (2, 4) alikho kwigrafu. Ngoko ayidibani ne-y=4. Kwamanye amaxabiso ka-k, x=k−2≠2, ngoko idibana kwindawo enye.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Akukho nanye. Idibana kuyo yonke k
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Awuzange ubonakalise ulwazi lokuba ichaphaza alikho kwi-x=2.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ekubeni x=2, ucinge k=2. Uxubile iindima zekhowudinethi ye-x neye-y.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ngoku qwalasela umgca y=mx odlula kwimvelaphi negrafu ye-f. Ukusuka kwi-x+2=mx, x=2/(m−1) (m≠1).
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kwi-m yexabiso lini y=mx nengrafu ye-f ingadibani?
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukuba m=1, x+2=x ayinasisombululo, ngoko imigca iyafana kwaye ayidibani. Ukuba m=2, x=2, ngoko bekufanele zidibane kwichaphaza elilahlekileyo (2, 4), kodwa eli chaphaza lilahlekile, ngoko azidibani. Kufuneka uhlale uhlola ukuba isisombululo osifumeneyo asingo-x=2.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uhlole kuphela ukuba x+2=mx ayinasisombululo xa m=1. Awuhlolanga ukuba x oyifumeneyo ikumhlaba na.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ujonge kuphela imeko apho x oyifumeneyo ingu-2. Cinga nangemeko apho kungekho sisombululo kwaphela.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni ndijonge kuphela umgca onciphisiweyo ndacinga ukuba ihlala idibana, kodwa ngolwazi lokuba ichaphaza lilahlekile kwa-x=2, ndafunda ukuba y=4 no-y=2x azidibani nalo. Isisombululo esifunyenwe kwikhweshini eyenziwe lula ngokunciphisa kufuneka sihlolwe kwakhona ngemeko yomhlaba womsebenzi wokuqala.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s2.prompt: Chaza ukuba kutheni y=2x negrafu ye-f zingadibani, udibanisa inkqubo yokusombulula ikhweshini nexabiso lika-x.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola okwenzekayo xa ufaka eli xabiso lika-x kwikhweshini yokuqala (x²−4)/(x−2).
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ufumene ukuba isisombululo x sekhweshini yintoni?
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uhlole ukuba eso sisombululo sikumhlaba na?
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s2.model.0: Ukusombulula x+2=2x kunika x=2, kodwa f inenani elingaphantsi elingu-0 kwa-x=2, ngoko ayichazwanga. Ngoko nangona kubonakala ngathi kukho isisombululo, ichaphaza lilahlekile kwigrafu yokwenyani, ngoko azidibani.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s2.model.1: Ukufumana ukudibana ngekhweshini enciphisiweyo kunika x=2, kodwa eli xabiso likhutshiwe kumhlaba womsebenzi wokuqala. Ichaphaza (2, 4) lilahlekile kwigrafu, ngoko alidibani nomgca y=2x.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.prompt: Khetha umsebenzi ografu yawo ingumgca onechaphaza elinye kuphela elilahlekileyo.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.hint.0: Wahlula inani elingasentla lekhweshini nganye uhlole ukuba likho na icandelo elinciphisa nenani elingaphantsi.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuba ikhweshini eseleyo emva kokunciphisa ilinganayo (umgca) na, nokuba ixabiso lika-x elenza inani elingaphantsi libe ngu-0 lingakanani kwikhweshini enciphisiweyo.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.r.a: Ligophe elinoasimptote kwa-x=1, apho inani elingaphantsi li-0. Hlola ukuba inani elingasentla liba ngu-0 nakwa-x ofanayo na.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.r.c: Inani elingasentla alwahlulwa ibe zizinto kwaye akukho nto inciphisayo. Ayingomgca.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.r.d: Iyancipha, kodwa ikhweshini enciphisiweyo 1/(x−1) ligophe, hayi umgca.
n-m-h1-func-04.s.s3.explain: y=(x²−9)/(x+3)=x−3 (x≠−3), ngoko kuphela ichaphaza (−3, −6) elilahlekileyo kumgca y=x−3. Kwi-d, nasemva kokunciphisa, y=1/(x−1) (x≠−1), ngoko ayingomgca.

n-m-h1-func-01.title: Umsebenzi odityanisiweyo owenziwe lula ibinzana: ingaba umda awutshintshanga?
n-m-h1-func-01.topic: Imisebenzi neegrafu: imisebenzi edityanisiweyo nephambeneyo, imisebenzi eyiqhezu nengekho ngqiqweni, imida yomda
n-m-h1-func-01.goal: Emva kokwenza lula ibinzana lomsebenzi odityanisiweyo, hlola ukuba imeko yomda womsebenzi wangaphakathi isahleli, uze ufumane uphinde ubhale impazamo kwisisombululo.
n-m-h1-func-01.material: Kwi-f(x)=x² (umda: onke amanani eneneni) kunye ne-g(x)=√(x−2), uMinsu wasombulula umsebenzi odityanisiweyo f∘g ngolu hlobo.
n-m-h1-func-01.thinking.0: Wahlula ibinzana elenziwe lula kumda womsebenzi wokuqala
n-m-h1-func-01.thinking.1: Fumana imizekelo yokudityaniswa apho imeko inyamalala
n-m-h1-func-01.prereq.1: Iimeko zokuba ingcambu yesikwere ibe yeneneni
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo sikaMinsu.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuba ulandelelwano lokufumana i-f∘g kukubala g kuqala emva koko ufake eso siphumo kwi-f.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s1.hint.1: Faka amaxabiso ambalwa anje nge-x=0 no-x=5 kwi-g kuqala uhlole ukuba ubalo lunokugqitywa.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s1.line.2: Ngoko umda we-f∘g onke amanani eneneni.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-3 uphosakele. Ukubala (f∘g)(x)=f(g(x)), g(x) kufuneka kuqala imiselwe njengenani leneneni. Nokuba ibinzana lenziwa lula libe yi-x−2, umda x≥2 ka-g awunyamalali. Umgca wesi-4 sisiphumo esilandela umgca wesi-3.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.prompt: Phakathi kwemisebenzi edityanisiweyo elandelayo f∘g, khetha yonke apho umda ushiyeka nokuba ibinzana lenziwe lula.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, kuqala khangela i-x enganakufakwa kwi-g.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qokelela kuphela i-x apho g(x) ichazwa, uze uhlole nokuba eli xabiso lingafakwa kwi-f.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.r.a: Ubone kuphela ukuba ibonakala njenge-x+3 emva kokwenza lula waza wasilela imeko yomda ka-g. Hlola ukuba x yeyo apho umsebenzi wangaphakathi uchazwa khona.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.r.b: g(x)=x² ichazwa kuyo yonke i-x, kwaye ixabiso x² elifakwe kwi-f li-0 ubuncinane, ngoko akukho mda. Jonga nokuba ibinzana elenziwe lula li-|x|.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.r.c: Wenziwa lula ibe yi-x, kodwa usilele kwimeko yokuba g ayichazwanga kwi-x=0.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.r.d: Imisebenzi yomibini ichazwa kuwo onke amanani eneneni, kwaye ukudibanisa ayenzi mda mtsha.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s2.explain: Kwi-a, imeko x≥−3 isahleli kumsebenzi wangaphakathi g, kwaye kwi-c, x≠0. Kwi-b, √(x²)=|x| ichazwa kuwo onke amanani eneneni. d ayinamda. Nokuba ibinzana lenziwa lula, i-x apho umsebenzi wangaphakathi ungachazwanga isuswa kumda womsebenzi odityanisiweyo.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s3.prompt: Lungisa isisombululo sikaMinsu, bhala umda we-f∘g, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni (f∘g)(0) ingamiselwanga.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s3.hint.0: Emva kokufumana ibinzana x−2, bhala kwakhona ukuba f∘g ichazwa kwi-x ephi.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuba ixabiso eliphakathi kukubala g(0) lineneni na.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba wahlule ukuba ibinzana x−2 nomsebenzi f∘g bangabi bafanayo?
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s3.model.0: Ibinzana le-f∘g li-x−2, kodwa ngenxa yomda ka-g lichazwa kuphela kwi-x≥2. Kwi-x=0, g(0)=√(−2) ayiyeneneni, ngoko (f∘g)(0) ayichazwanga.
n-m-h1-func-01.s.s3.model.1: (f∘g)(x)=x−2 (apho x≥2). 0 ayingu-2 ubuncinane, ngoko ayiyomda, kwaye ixabiso −2 alinakuvela.

n-m-h1-func-02.topic: Imisebenzi neegrafu: imisebenzi edityanisiweyo nephambeneyo, imisebenzi eyiqhezu nengekho ngqiqweni, imida yomda
n-m-h1-func-02.title: Ukufumana umsebenzi ophambeneyo womsebenzi oyiqhezu nokuwuthelekisa nebinzana lokuqala
n-m-h1-func-02.goal: Fumana umsebenzi ophambeneyo womsebenzi oyiqhezu ngqo uwuthelekise nebinzana lokuqala, uze wenze amabinzana amaninzi anempawu evezwa kuthelekiso uze uchaze isakhiwo sawo.
n-m-h1-func-02.material: Sifuna ukufumana umsebenzi ophambeneyo f⁻¹(x) womsebenzi f(x)=(2x+3)/(x−2) (x≠2). Tshintshanisa x no-y uze usombulule i-y.
n-m-h1-func-02.thinking.2: Chaza usebenzisa unxulumano phakathi kwee-asymptote ne-y=x
n-m-h1-func-02.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yomsebenzi ophambeneyo nendlela yokuwufumana (tshintshanisa x no-y usombulule i-y)
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ukusuka kwi-y=(2x+3)/(x−2), bhala ibinzana elinx no-y zitshintshisiwe, susa inani elingaphantsi, uze uqokelele amalungu e-y kwelinye icala.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s1.hint.1: Faka ixabiso le-f(3) kwibinzana olikhethileyo uhlole ukuba 3 iyabuya.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s1.r.a: Uthathe umsebenzi ophambeneyo njengofanayo nobuchaseneyo. Vavanya ngexabiso elinye ukuba f(f⁻¹(x))=x.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s1.r.c: Ucinge ukuba ukutshintsha uphawu kuphela kunika f⁻¹. Faka f(3)=9 kweli binzana uhlole ukuba 3 iyaphuma.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s1.r.d: Utshintshe uphawu gwenxa ngelixa ulungisa i-y emva kokutshintshanisa x no-y. Hlola ngokufaka f(3)=9.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s1.explain: Ukusombulula x=(2y+3)/(y−2) ukufumana y kunika xy−2x=2y+3, y(x−2)=2x+3, ngoko y=(2x+3)/(x−2). Umsebenzi ophambeneyo uphuma ngebinzana elifanayo nomsebenzi wokuqala. Hlola: f(3)=9, f⁻¹(9)=3.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza imisebenzi emibini eyiqhezu eyahlukileyo enempawu ye-f yenyathelo lokuqala (oko kwavezwa xa wafumana umsebenzi ophambeneyo wawuthelekisa nebinzana lokuqala), uze ufake amanani apheleleyo a, b, c, d e-f(x)=(ax+b)/(cx+d). (Ngamanani apheleleyo asuka kwi-−6 ukuya kwi-6, c ayingu-0, kwaye ad−bc akufuneki ibe ngu-0. Isiphindaphindi esiqhelekileyo somsebenzi ofanayo sibalwa njengesinye.)
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kwibinzana jikelele y=(ax+b)/(cx+d), tshintshanisa x no-y, sombulula i-y, uze uthelekise amakoyifishenti omnye ngomnye nesiphumo senyathelo lokuqala.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.hint.1: Beka isiphumo somsebenzi ophambeneyo webinzana jikelele ecaleni kwebinzana le-f, uze ubhale ukuba loluphi uhlobo lwemeko olufunekayo kumakoyifishenti ukuze amabinzana amabini alingane.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a, b, c, d kufuneka zibe ngamanani apheleleyo asuka kwi-−6 ukuya kwi-6.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Ukuba ad−bc=0, ngumsebenzi ongatshintshiyo kwaye awunamsebenzi ophambeneyo.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Umsebenzi ophambeneyo webinzana elingalingani no-f. Bala f(f(x)) okanye ufumane umsebenzi ophambeneyo uze uthelekise.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s2.explain: Umsebenzi ophambeneyo ngu-f⁻¹(x)=(−dx+b)/(cx−a). Ukuze ulingane no-f, sidinga a=−d. Imizekelo: (x+1)/(x−1), (2x+3)/(x−2), 4/x.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.prompt: Kwimisebenzi emibini oyenzileyo, fumana ii-asymptote (x=○, y=○) zenye nenye, uzithelekise omnye komnye, uze ubhale ukuba ii-asymptote ziqhelekile ntoni xa f=f⁻¹.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kwibinzana ngalinye owenzileyo, fumana ixabiso le-x elenza inani elingaphantsi libe ngu-0 nexabiso y elisondela kulo xa x iba nkulu kakhulu.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.hint.1: Fumana iikhowudinethi zendawo yokunqumlana yee-asymptote ezimbini uze uthelekise indawo yayo nomgca y=x.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ufumene ii-asymptote x=−d/c, y=a/c uzithelekise?
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uqhagamshele oku kwinto yokuba iigrafu ze-f ne-f⁻¹ zilungelelene malunga ne-y=x?
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.model.0: Umzekelo, (x+1)/(x−1) inee-asymptote x=1, y=1, kwaye (2x+3)/(x−2) inee-x=2, y=2. Amaxabiso amabini ayalingana, ngoko indawo yokunqumlana yee-asymptote ilele kwi-y=x.
n-m-h1-func-02.s.s3.model.1: Iigrafu ze-f ne-f⁻¹ zilungelelene malunga ne-y=x, ngoko ukuba f=f⁻¹, igrafu ye-f ngokwayo ilungelelene malunga ne-y=x. Ngoko amaxabiso ee-asymptote x=p no-y=p kufuneka alingane.

n-m-h1-func-03.topic: Imisebenzi neegrafu: imisebenzi edityanisiweyo nephambeneyo, imisebenzi eyiqhezu nengekho ngqiqweni, imida yomda
n-m-h1-func-03.title: Ingaba amachaphaza apho f nomsebenzi wayo ophambeneyo badibana khona onke alele kumgca y=x?
n-m-h1-func-03.goal: Chonga imeko efunekayo ukuthi zonke iindawo zokunqumlana zeegrafu ze-f ne-f⁻¹ zilele kwi-y=x, uze wenze umzekelo ochasayo ukuchaza ukuba kutheni loo meko ifuneka.
n-m-h1-func-03.material: f ukuhambelana kunye-nanye kweseti yawo onke amanani eneneni kwiseti yawo onke amanani eneneni, ngoko inomsebenzi ophambeneyo f⁻¹. UJiyeon uthi ukufumana amachaphaza apho iigrafu ze-f ne-f⁻¹ zidibana khona, kufuneka usombulule nje ulingano f(x)=x. Sifuna ukufumanisa ukuba kufuneka sazi ntoni ngo-f ukuze loo ngxelo ihlale iyinyani.
n-m-h1-func-03.thinking.2: Phikisa ukuba iindawo zokunqumlana zilele kwi-y=x xa imeko ibambile
n-m-h1-func-03.prereq.0: Igrafu yomsebenzi ophambeneyo ilungelelene malunga ne-y=x
n-m-h1-func-03.prereq.1: Intsingiselo yomsebenzi onyukayo (ukuba a<b ngoko f(a)<f(b))
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.prompt: Ukuthi ngokuqinisekileyo "onke amachaphaza apho iigrafu ze-f ne-f⁻¹ zidibana khona alele kumgca y=x", kuyiphi kwezi kufuneka sazi ngo-f?
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga imeko nganye enye ngexesha, uze ujonge phakathi kwemisebenzi yomgca i-f eneliseka loo meko kodwa idibana ngaphandle komgca y=x.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa iigrafu ze-f ne-f⁻¹ kumsebenzi womgca onyukayo f(x)=2x+1 nomsebenzi womgca ohlayo f(x)=−x+3.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.r.a: Zoba zombini f no-f⁻¹ kumsebenzi f(x)=−x, odlula kwimvelaphi. Jonga ukuba iigrafu ezimbini zidibana nangaphandle kwe-y=x.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.r.b: Ukudibana nomgca y=x kuthetha ukuba kukho indawo yokunqumlana kwi-y=x; akuthethi ukuba akukho ezinye iindawo zokunqumlana. Hlola nge-f(x)=−x+3.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.r.c: Phakathi kwemisebenzi yomgca enamagrafu aqhagamshelweyo, ezinye apho f no-f⁻¹ ngumgca omnye. Hlola ngomsebenzi womgca onethambeka elinegethivu.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.o.d: f ngumsebenzi onyukayo (njengoko x ikhula, f(x) ikhula)
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s1.explain: Ukuba f ngumsebenzi onyukayo, zonke iindawo zokunqumlana zika-f no-f⁻¹ zilele kwi-y=x. Ezinye iimeko zonke zineemizekelo ezichasayo. f(x)=−x+3 inegrafu eqhagamshelweyo kwaye idibana ne-y=x nayo, kodwa f no-f⁻¹ ngumgca omnye, ngoko badibana nangaphandle kwe-y=x. f(x)=−x idlula kwimvelaphi kodwa isilela ngesizathu esifanayo.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.prompt: Vumela f(x)=mx+n (m≠0), uze wenze imisebenzi yomgca emibini eyahlukileyo ukuze iigrafu ze-f ne-f⁻¹ zidibane kwindawo (t, f(t)) engekho kumgca y=x, uze ufake m, n, t. (Amanani apheleleyo asuka kwi-−9 ukuya kwi-9)
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala fumana umsebenzi ophambeneyo we-f(x)=mx+n uze umisele ibinzana elithi f no-f⁻¹ banexabiso elifanayo kwi-x efanayo.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha amathambeka ahlukeneyo, fumana amabinzana e-f ne-f⁻¹, sombulula i-x apho amabinzana amabini alingana khona, uze uhlole ukuba indawo ikwi-y=x na.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Zinani eliphelele ngaphakathi koluhlu kwaye m ayingu-0.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.fail.c1: m, n, t kufuneka zibe ngamanani apheleleyo asuka kwi-−9 ukuya kwi-9 kwaye m akufuneki ibe ngu-0.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Kwi-x=t, f(t) no-f⁻¹(t) abalingani. Bala f⁻¹(t)=(t−n)/m uze uthelekise.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s2.explain: Umsebenzi ophambeneyo we-f(x)=mx+n yi-(x−n)/m, kwaye iigrafu ezimbini zidibana ngaphandle kwe-y=x kwimeko apho m=−1 kwaye f no-f⁻¹ ngumgca omnye. Umzekelo: f(x)=−x+2, indawo (0, 2).
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s3.prompt: Bhala ukuba kutheni, xa f ngumsebenzi onyukayo, zonke iindawo zokunqumlana zeegrafu ze-f ne-f⁻¹ zilele kwi-y=x.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ukuba indawo yokunqumlana (a, b) ikwigrafu ye-f kwaye ikwigrafu ye-f⁻¹ nayo, bhala ukuba f(a) no-f(b) nganye yintoni.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga a<b uze usebenzise inkcazo yomsebenzi onyukayo kwi-f(a) nakwi-f(b).
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba indawo yokunqumlana yi-(a, b), ngoko f(a)=b kwaye f(b)=a. Ukuba a<b, f iyanyuka ngoko f(a)<f(b), nto leyo inika b<a, ukuphikisana. a>b iyafana, ngoko ekugqibeleni a=b.
n-m-h1-func-03.s.s3.model.1: Ukusuka kwi-f(a)=b nakwi-f(b)=a, ukuba a<b ngoko ekubeni f iyanyuka f(a)<f(b), oko kukuthi b<a, nto engenakwenzeka. Ngokunjalo a>b ayinakwenzeka, ngoko a=b kwaye indawo yokunqumlana ikwi-y=x.

n-m-h1-func-05.topic: Imisebenzi neegrafu: imisebenzi edityanisiweyo nephambeneyo, imisebenzi eyiqhezu nengekho ngqiqweni, imida yomda
n-m-h1-func-05.title: Ikhweshini engengqiqo ezombululwe ngokwenza isikwere: ngaba isisombululo sinokuthenjwa?
n-m-h1-func-05.goal: Phonononga indlela iingcambu ezitshintsha ngayo xa kusonjululwa ikhweshini engengqiqo ngokwenza isikwere, khetha izisombululo ezinokuthenjwa, uze wenze ikhweshini enjalo ngokwakho.
n-m-h1-func-05.material:
Abafundi abahlanu basombulule ikhweshini engengqiqo √(x+6)=x ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo.
· UGayoung: Wenze macala omabini isikwere wafumana x+6=x², oko kukuthi, x²−x−6=0, wafumana x=3 okanye x=−2, wathi zombini ziingcambu.
· UNarae: Wafaka x=3 no-x=−2 abafunyenwe ngokwenza isikwere kwikhweshini yokuqala wathi kuphela x=3 yingcambu.
· UDaon: Kuba icala lasekhohlo lekhweshini yokuqala li-0 okanye ngaphezulu, wabhala kuqala x≥0, wathi kumaxabiso afunyenwe ngokwenza isikwere, kuphela x=3, enelisa x≥0, yingcambu.
· URahee: Wazoba iigrafu ze-y=√(x+6) kunye ne-y=x, wafunda amakhowudinethi e-x okudibana, wathi kuphela x=3 yingcambu.
· UMaru: Wacinga ukuba ukuba macala omabini alinganayo ngoko iikwere zawo ziyalingana, ngoko ikhweshini eyenziwe isikwere nekhweshini yokuqala zineengcambu ezifanayo, wathi zombini x=3 no-x=−2 ziingcambu.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke iindlela zokusombulula esinokuthembela esigqibeni sazo ukuba sichanekile.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.hint.0: Faka x=3 no-x=−2 kumacala asekhohlo nasekunene ekhweshini yokuqala √(x+6)=x uthelekise amaxabiso.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ukusuka ku-A²=B², bhala zombini A=B no-A=−B, uze ucinge ukuba leyiphi evumelana nekhweshini yokuqala.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.o.a: UNarae: Wafaka amaxabiso afunyenwe ngokwenza isikwere kwikhweshini yokuqala wahlola
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.o.b: UGayoung: Wathatha onke amaxabiso amabini avela ekwenzeni isikwere njengeengcambu njengoko enjalo
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.r.b: Ucinge ukuba iingcambu zekhweshini eyenziwe isikwere ziingcambu zekhweshini yokuqala. Faka amaxabiso amabini kwikhweshini yokuqala uhlole ukuba macala omabini alinganayo na.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.o.c: UDaon: Kuba icala lasekhohlo li-0 okanye ngaphezulu, wabhala kuqala imeko x≥0 emva koko wenza isikwere
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.o.d: URahee: Wafunda amakhowudinethi e-x okudibana kwegrafu zemisebenzi emibini
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.o.e: UMaru: Wacinga ukuba ukuba macala omabini alinganayo ngoko iikwere zawo ziyalingana, ngoko iingcambu ziyafana
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.r.e: Awuhlolanga ukuba isalathiso esibuyayo ukusuka kwikhweshini eyenziwe isikwere ukuya kwikhweshini yokuqala sihlala sinyaniso na. Ukuba A=B ngoko A²=B², kodwa hlola okwenzekayo kwicala elichasene.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s1.explain: Ukuba A=B ngoko A²=B², kodwa ukuba A²=B² ngoko A=B okanye A=−B. Ngoko emva kokwenza isikwere kufuneka uhlole iimpendulo, okanye uncamathisele imeko B≥0 ukususela ekuqaleni. Ukudibana kwegrafu kusebenzisa imeko efanayo ngokuzenzekelayo. Kwa-x=−2, √4=2 ngelixa icala lasekunene li-−2, ngoko ayiyongcambu.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s2.prompt: Chaza ukuba kutheni x=−2, efunyenwe ngokwenza isikwere, ingeyongcambu yekhweshini yokuqala, usebenzisa amaxabiso amacala asekhohlo nasekunene xa x=−2 ifakwa endaweni.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s2.hint.0: Faka x=−2 ngokwahlukeneyo kumacala asekhohlo nasekunene ekhweshini yokuqala √(x+6)=x ubale.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa ikhweshini eyenziwe isikwere 4=4 namaxabiso amabini avela kwikhweshini yokuqala.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s2.model.0: Ukufaka x=−2, icala lasekhohlo li-√4=2 kwaye lasekunene li-−2, ngoko amaxabiso amabini ayahluka. Ingcambu yesikwere i-0 okanye ngaphezulu kodwa icala lasekunene lithabatha, ngoko ayinakuba yingcambu.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s2.model.1: Icala lasekhohlo li-√(−2+6)=2 kwaye lasekunene li-−2. 2 no-−2 aziselingani, ngoko ayiyongcambu. Ukwenza isikwere kususa uphawu kwaye kwenza 4=4, ngoko yabonakala njengengcambu.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.prompt: Kwikhweshini engengqiqo √(x+a)=x+b, ngenisa amanani aphelele a, b ukuze ikhweshini yequadratic efunyenwe ngokwenza macala omabini isikwere ibe neengcambu ezimbini ezipheleleyo kwaye enye kanye kuzo ibe yingcambu yekhweshini yokuqala. (Amanani aphelele asuka kwi-−6 ukuya kwi-12; ukhuphe ikhweshini efanayo no-√(x+6)=x ngentla.)
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.hint.0: Yenza isikwere ubhale ikhweshini yequadratic ku-x, uze ucinge ukuba idiskriminanti kufuneka ibe linani lini ukuze iingcambu ezimbini zibe ngamanani aphelele.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.hint.1: Zama amaxabiso ambalwa ka-a no-b, uze kwingcambu nganye oyifumanayo uyifake kwikhweshini yokuqala uhlole ukuba x+b i-0 okanye ngaphezulu.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.fail.c1: a no-b kufuneka babe ngamanani aphelele asuka kwi-−6 ukuya kwi-12.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.ok.c3: Iingcambu zekhweshini eyenziwe isikwere ngamanani aphelele amabini ahlukeneyo kwaye enye kuzo ayiyongcambu yekhweshini yokuqala.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.fail.c3: Sombulula ikhweshini eyenziwe isikwere x+a=(x+b)² uhlole ukuba iingcambu ziyinani eliphelele elimbini na kwaye enye kanye ine-x+b≥0.
n-m-h1-func-05.s.s3.explain: Ukusuka kwi-x+a=(x+b)², sifumana x²+(2b−1)x+b²−a=0. Idiskriminanti yi-4(a−b)+1, ngoko xa le sisikwere esigqibeleleyo esikhulu kune-1, iingcambu ezimbini ezipheleleyo ziyavela, kwaye kuphela ingcambu encinci ine-x+b<0. Umzekelo: (3, 1) inika √(x+3)=x+1, kwaye kuphela ingcambu 1 iyasebenza.

n-m-h1-func-06.topic: Imisebenzi neegrafu: imisebenzi edityanisiweyo nephambeneyo, imisebenzi eyiqhezu nengekho ngqiqweni, imida yomda
n-m-h1-func-06.title: Ukwenza nokufumana yonke imisebenzi engengqiqo ehlangabezana neemeko
n-m-h1-func-06.goal: Yenza ikhweshini ezinokwenzeka ngokwakho xa uluhlu nechaphaza kumsebenzi ongengqiqo zinikiwe, ubale iimeko ezinokwenzeka ngaphandle kokuphosa phantsi kwemeko yokuba ngamanani aphelele.
n-m-h1-func-06.material: Sifuna ukwenza umsebenzi ongengqiqo y=a√(x−b)+c (a, b, c ngamanani aphelele, a≠0). Iimeko: ① uluhlu yi-y≤3 ② igrafu idlula kwichaphaza (7, −1), kwaye eli chaphaza alilochaphaza lokuqala lomhlaba (x=b<7). Kwakhona, −9≤a≤9, −10≤b≤10, −9≤c≤9.
n-m-h1-func-06.prereq.1: Ukuba ingcambu yesikwere inengqiqo, inani eliphantsi kophawu lwengcambu lisikwere esigqibeleleyo
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.prompt: Ukusuka kwimeko ① (uluhlu yi-y≤3), khetha oko ungakuqukumbela malunga no-a no-c.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.hint.0: Thelekisa okwenzeka kwa-y njengoko x ikhula xa a ibonakalisa ngokongeza nalapho a ithabatha, ngokufaka amaxabiso.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.hint.1: Wahlula imeko apho indawo yokuqala (b, c) yegrafu iyindawo ephezulu kuneyo apho iyeyona iphantsi.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba a>0, ngoko y≥c, ngoko igrafu inyuka ngaphandle komda. Hlola ukuba oko kuhambelana noluhlu lwe-y≤3.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.r.b: b imisela apho umhlaba uqala khona. Ayifani nexabiso eliphezulu loluhlu.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.r.d: Ukuba c incinci kune-3, ixabiso eliphezulu loluhlu li-c, ngoko alifikeleli kwi-3. Hlola ukuba uluhlu lufanele ngqo ukuba yi-y≤3.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s1.explain: Ukuba a<0, ngoko y iba ncinci njengoko √(x−b) ikhula, ngoko y inexabiso layo eliphezulu c kwa-x=b. Ukuze uluhlu lube yi-y≤3, c kufuneka ibe ngu-3.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s2.prompt: Yenza imisebenzi emibini engengqiqo ehlukeneyo ehlangabezana neemeko zombini ① no-②, uze ungenise a, b, c kwenye nenye.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s2.hint.0: Emva kokumisela c ukusuka kwimeko ①, faka amakhowudinethi echaphaza (7, −1) kwikhweshini ukufumana ubudlelwane phakathi kuka-a no-b.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kuqala fumana ixabiso le-a√(7−b), uze uzame amanani anje ngo-1, 4, 9, 16 kwa-7−b uhlole ukuba a linani eliphelele na.
n-m-h1-func-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Onke ngamanani aphelele ngaphakathi koluhlu oluvumelekileyo, kwaye a ayingo-0.

n-m-h1-func-07.title: Ukuchaza Ulandelelwano Lokubuyisela Umsebenzi Odityanisiweyo Komzala Wesikolo Samabanga Aphakathi
n-m-h1-func-07.topic: Imisebenzi neegrafu: imisebenzi edityanisiweyo nechasayo, imisebenzi enengqiqo nengengqiqo, ukunciphisa umhlaba
n-m-h1-func-07.goal: Xa ufumana okuchasayo komsebenzi odityanisiweyo, hlola ulandelelwano apho umsebenzi ngamnye ubuyiselwa khona, uze ubhale inkcazelo enokuqondwa nangumfundi wesikolo samabanga aphakathi.
n-m-h1-func-07.material: Fumana i-(f∘g)⁻¹ xa f(x)=x+3 kunye no-g(x)=2x. Umzala wakho welibanga lesi-9 uthi, "Buyisela nje yomibini imisebenzi, ngoko kufuneka ibe yi-f⁻¹(g⁻¹(x)), akunjalo?"
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kuqala bhala i-f∘g(x)=f(g(x)) njengekhweshini, uze utshintshanise x no-y usombulule ngo-y.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s1.hint.1: Faka x=5 kwikhweshini oyikhethileyo, uze usebenzise ixabiso le-(f∘g)(1) ukuhlola ukuba ufumana u-1.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s1.r.a: Le yikhweshini oyifumana ngokwenza g⁻¹(x)=x/2 kuqala emva koko f⁻¹. Kuba (f∘g)(1)=5, hlola ukuba (f∘g)⁻¹(5) ingu-1 na.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s1.r.b: Ibuyisela kuphela f⁻¹ kwaye ayibuyiseli g. Faka ixabiso uhlole ukuba ufumana u-1 kwakhona.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s1.r.c: Ibuyisela kuphela g⁻¹ kwaye ayibuyiseli f. Faka ixabiso uhlole.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s1.explain: Kuba (f∘g)(x)=2x+3, ukusuka kwi-y=2x+3 sifumana x=(y−3)/2, oko kukuthi, (f∘g)⁻¹(x)=(x−3)/2. Oku kulingana no-g⁻¹(f⁻¹(x))=(x−3)/2, kwaye kwahlukile kwi-f⁻¹(g⁻¹(x))=x/2−3.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s2.prompt: Kwa-f(x)=px+q no-g(x)=rx+s (p no-r ngamanani aphelele angengo-0), ngenisa iinketho ezimbini zamanani aphelele p, q, r, s ukuze (f∘g)⁻¹(1) kunye ne-f⁻¹(g⁻¹(1)) zibe ngamaxabiso ahlukeneyo. (Ukusuka kwi-−5 ukuya kwi-5)
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana okuchasayo kuka-f(x)=px+q nokuka-g(x)=rx+s ngamnye, kwaye nokuchasayo kuka-(f∘g)(x).
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s2.hint.1: Faka x=1 kwikhweshini zombini uzame amaxabiso ka-p, q, r, s, uthelekisa ukuba iziphumo ziyalingana na.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Onke ngamanani aphelele ngaphakathi koluhlu oluvumelekileyo, kwaye p no-r abangu-0.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s2.fail.c1: p, q, r, s kufuneka babe ngamanani aphelele asuka kwi-−5 ukuya kwi-5, kwaye p no-r akufuneki babe ngu-0.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Amaxabiso amabini ayalingana. Fumana (f∘g)⁻¹(1) kunye ne-f⁻¹(g⁻¹(1)) ngokwahlukeneyo uzithelekise.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s2.explain: (f∘g)⁻¹(1)=(1−q−ps)/(pr) kunye ne-f⁻¹(g⁻¹(1))=(1−s−qr)/(pr). Ukuze zombini zilingane, q(1−r)=s(1−p) iyafuneka, ngoko kuninzi lwa-f no-g, ukutshintsha ulandelelwano kutshintsha ixabiso.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s3.prompt: Bhala inkcazelo kumzala wakho welibanga lesi-9 ye-"kutheni kufuneka sisebenzise g⁻¹(f⁻¹(x)) hayi f⁻¹(g⁻¹(x))", usebenzisa umzekelo f(x)=x+3, g(x)=2x. Yibhale ngamagama ukuze nabani ongayaziyo inotation aqonde.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s3.hint.0: Kwa-f(x)=x+3 no-g(x)=2x, bhala ukuba leliphi elenziwa kuqala kwi-(f∘g)(x)=f(g(x)).
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ngomsebenzi wemihla ngemihla onamanyathelo amabini, njengokunxiba izihlangu, uze uthelekise ulandelelwano lokuyibuyisela.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uchaze ulandelelwano lokuphinda kabini emva koko wongeze u-3?
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe leliphi eliza kuqala xa ubuyisela?
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba ngumatshini ophindaphinda x ngo-2 kuqala emva koko wongeze u-3, ukuyibuyisela kufuneka uhambe umva, uqale ngento yokugqibela eyenziweyo. Uthabatha u-3 kuqala emva koko wahlule ngo-2. Faka u-5 ufumane u-13, kwaye ukuthabatha u-3 kwi-13 nokwahlula ngo-2 kukubuyisela ku-5.
n-m-h1-func-07.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba unxiba iikawusi emva koko izihlangu, xa uzikhulula ukhulula izihlangu kuqala emva koko iikawusi, akunjalo? Lo msebenzi nawo waphinda kabini emva koko wongeza u-3, ngoko ukuwubuyisela uthabatha u-3 emva koko wahlule ngo-2. Ukuba utshintsha ulandelelwano ufumana x/2−3, okungalunganga.

n-m-h1-func-08.topic: Imisebenzi neegrafu: imisebenzi edityanisiweyo nechasayo, imisebenzi enengqiqo nengengqiqo, ukunciphisa umhlaba
n-m-h1-func-08.title: Singayiphindaphinda Macala Omabini Ngenani Elingaphantsi Kukungalingani Kweqhezu?
n-m-h1-func-08.goal: Xa macala omabini aphindaphindwa ngekhweshini enani layo elingaphantsi linokubonakalisa ngokongeza okanye ukuthabatha, sebenza okwenzeka kwicala lophawu lokungalingani, ufumane impazamo kwisisombululo, uze usombulule ngokuchanekileyo.
n-m-h1-func-08.material: U-Hajun wasombulula ukungalingani (x+3)/(x−1) ≥ 2 ngolu hlobo lulandelayo.
n-m-h1-func-08.prereq.0: Iipropati zokungalingani (ukuphindaphinda ngenani elithabathayo kujika uphawu lokungalingani)
n-m-h1-func-08.prereq.1: Ukufumana inani elingaphantsi eliqhelekileyo kwiikhweshini ezinengqiqo
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongachanekanga kwisisombululo sika-Hajun.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s1.hint.0: Wahlula kwimeko apho ikhweshini x−1 oyiphindaphinda ngayo ibonakalisa ngokongeza nakwimeko apho ithabatha, uze uhlole ipropati yokungalingani umgca nomgca.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s1.hint.1: Faka amaxabiso ka-x apho x−1 ithabatha nebonakalisa ngokongeza, njenge-x=0 kunye ne-x=3, kukungalingani kokuqala.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s1.line.1: Ukuphindaphinda macala omabini nge-x−1 kunika x+3 ≥ 2(x−1)
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s1.explain: Umgca 2 awulunganga. x−1 ibonakalisa ngokongeza ukuba x>1 kodwa ithabatha ukuba x<1. Ukuphindaphinda ngenani elithabathayo kujika uphawu lokungalingani, ngoko awukwazi ukuphindaphinda ngendlela efanayo kwiimeko zombini. Imigca 3 no-4 ilandela kumgca 2.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s2.prompt: Khetha onke amaxabiso ahlala kwimpendulo ka-Hajun "x ≤ 5 (apho x≠1)" kodwa angayanelisi ukungalingani kokuqala (x+3)/(x−1) ≥ 2.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s2.hint.0: Faka ixabiso ngalinye kwicala lasekhohlo lokungalingani kokuqala (x+3)/(x−1) ≥ 2 ubale ukuba ngokwenene li-2 okanye ngaphezulu na.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s2.hint.1: Phawula ngokwahlukeneyo ukuba ixabiso ngalinye lingeniswa na kwimpendulo kaHajun nokuba liyanelisa na ukungalingani kwangaphambili, uze ubambanise iziphumo ezibini.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s2.r.a: (3+3)/(3−1)=3≥2, ngoko eli xabiso lanelisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili. Lingena kwimpendulo, kodwa asingomzekelo ochasayo.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s2.r.c: (5+3)/(5−1)=2, ngoko eli xabiso lanelisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili. Asingomzekelo ochasayo.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s2.explain: Xa x=0 ixabiso li−3 yaye xa x=−3 li-0, ngoko akukho kwabo lilingana okanye likhulu kuno-2. x=3 no-x=5 zanelisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili. Kwi-x<1, akukho xabiso lanelisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s3.prompt: Fumana isisombululo esichanekileyo sokungalingani (x+3)/(x−1) ≥ 2, uze uchaze enye indlela yokusifumana.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s3.hint.0: Hambisa u-2 uye ngakwicala langasekhohlo ukwenza iqhezu elinye, uze ubukele iimpawu zenani elingasentla nelingaphantsi.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s3.hint.1: Yahlula ibe yimeko ye-x>1 neyemeko ye-x<1, uze unike isigqibo ngecala lophawu lokungalingani kwindawo nganye.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba usombulule ngokwahlukeneyo imeko apho u-x−1 ungqinelana nenani elilungileyo kunye nemeko apho uyinegethivu?
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Okanye ngaba uhambise u-2, wafumana inani elingaphantsi eliqhelekileyo, wabukela iimpawu?
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s3.model.0: Ukuhambisa u-2 nokufumana inani elingaphantsi eliqhelekileyo kunika (5−x)/(x−1) ≥ 0. Inani elingasentla nelingaphantsi kufuneka libe nophawu olufanayo, okanye inani elingasentla libe ngu-0, ngoko 1<x≤5.
n-m-h1-func-08.s.s3.model.1: Xa x>1, u-x−1 uyipositivu, ngoko uphawu lokungalingani lusala lunjalo yaye x≤5, oko kukuthi 1<x≤5. Xa x<1, uphawu luyajika yaye x≥5, ngoko akukho x oyanelisayo. Ngoko isisombululo yi-1<x≤5.

n-m-h1-mat-01.title: Ukufumana ii-matrix ezi-2×2 ezinelisa A²=−E
n-m-h1-mat-01.goal: Guqula ulingano A²=−E libe ziimeko kwiintlobo zamalungu, yakha ii-matrix ezinelisa ngokwakho, uze uchaze into eqhelekileyo kwimizekelo oyenzileyo nokuba kutheni, ngokwahlula ngeemeko.
n-m-h1-mat-01.material: Kwinani leneneni x, akukho x yeneneni ene-x²=−1. Ngoko ke ii-matrix ezi-2×2 A ezine-A²=−E zinjani? Apha i-matrix [[a,b],[c,d]] yi-matrix ye-2×2 emgca wayo wokuqala ungu-a, b kwaye emgca wayo wesibini ungu-c, d. E yi-matrix yesazisi [[1,0],[0,1]]. −E yi-[[−1,0],[0,−1]]. Sebenzisa amalungu apheleleyo kuphela.
n-m-h1-mat-01.thinking.0: Ukuvavanya ukuba ingqiqo evela kumanani eneneni (isikwere asinakuba negethivu) inokusetyenziswa kwii-matrix njengoko injalo
n-m-h1-mat-01.thinking.1: Ukuguqula ulingano lwe-matrix lube ngokulingana kwamalungu nokwakha imizekelo
n-m-h1-mat-01.thinking.2: Ukufumana isakhiwo esiqhelekileyo kwimizekelo nokuchaza ukuba kutheni ngokwahlula ngeemeko
n-m-h1-mat-01.prereq.0: Indlela yokufumana ilungu le-(i,j) kuphindaphindo lwe-matrix
n-m-h1-mat-01.prereq.1: Ukuba −E yi-matrix yesazisi enophawu lwalo lonke ilungu lutshintshiwe
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha amalungu achanekileyo esikwere A²=A×A kwi-A=[[a,b],[c,d]]. (Ilungu le-(1,1) liyiseli emgceni wokuqala nakwikholam yokuqala, kwaye ilungu le-(1,2) liyiseli emgceni wokuqala nakwikholam yesibini.)
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s1.hint.0: Endaweni ka-a, b, c, d, faka amanani anje nge-1, 2, 3, 4 ubale A×A ngqo, uze uthelekise nexabiso olifumana ngokufaka amanani afanayo kwifomula kukhetho ngalunye.
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s1.hint.1: Maka ukuba ngumgca muni nekholam enjani ye-A edityaniswa, iphindaphindwe, yongezwe ukufumana ilungu le-(1,2).
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s1.r.a: Yenze ibhokisi nganye isikwere ngokwahlukeneyo. Ukuphindaphinda imatrikhsi kudibanisa umqolo nekholam, kuphindaphinda, kwaye kudibanise, nto leyo eyahlukileyo ekwenzeni ibhokisi nganye isikwere.
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s1.r.c: Ilungu (1,1) lichanekile, kodwa kwi-(1,2) edibanise umqolo wokuqala nekholam yesibini ngokungalunganga. Umqolo wokuqala yi-(a, b) kwaye ikholam yesibini yi-(b, d).
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s1.r.d: Idibanise umqolo wokuqala nawo ngokwawo. Kwi-(1,1), umqolo wokuqala (a, b) kufuneka udityaniswe nekholam yokuqala (a, c).
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s1.explain: Ukudibanisa umqolo wokuqala (a, b) nekholam yokuqala (a, c) kunika ilungu (1,1) a·a+b·c=a²+bc, kwaye ukuwudibanisa nekholam yesibini (b, d) kunika ilungu (1,2) a·b+b·d=b(a+d). Ngendlela efanayo, ilungu (2,1) yi-c(a+d) kwaye ilungu (2,2) yi-d²+bc.
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s2.prompt: Fumana uze ungenise amaseti amathathu ahlukeneyo amanani aphelele a, b, c, d ukuze A²=−E, oko kukuthi, iibhokisi ezine ze-A² zi-−1, 0, 0, −1 ngokulandelelana.
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala bhala njengeekhweshini iimeko zokuba ilungu (1,2) nelungu (2,1) kufuneka zibe ngu-0, uze wahlule ngeemeko xa imveliso ingu-0.
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuba b no-c banokuba ngu-0 bobabini na, kwaye ukuba hayi, misela a no-d kwiimeko ezisele.
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, ukuba A=[[0,−1],[1,0]], ngoko A²=[[−1,0],[0,−1]]=−E. Akukho nani eliyinyani x elinokwanelisa x²=−1, kodwa ezinye iimatrikhsi ziyakwenza, kwaye zininzi. [[0,1],[1,0]] ayisebenzi kuba isikwere sayo yi-E, kwaye E okanye −E ayisebenzi kuba isikwere sayo yi-E.
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Thelekisa imizekelo oyenzileyo, ufumane ubhale ubudlelwane phakathi kuka-a no-d obusebenza kuyo yonke, uze uchaze nokuba kutheni obo budlelwane bufuneka ngokuqinisekileyo.
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kumzekelo ngamnye, bala amaxabiso anje nge-a+d, a−d, kunye no-a×d, uwabhale macala ngamacala, uze uthelekise oko kufanayo.
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bhala iimeko zokuba amalungu (1,2) kunye (2,1) e-A² abe ngu-0, uze ucinge ukuba b no-c banokuba ngu-0 bobabini na.
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubale a+d ngokwakho kumzekelo ngamnye owenzileyo?
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ucinge ngokwahlukeneyo ngemeko apho b no-c bobabini bengu-0?
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ukusuka kwimeko yelungu (1,2), ungachaza ukuba lelipi inani eliphindaphindwayo ukufumana u-0?
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Kuyo yonke imizekelo, a+d=0, oko kukuthi, d=−a. Ilungu (1,2) yi-b(a+d)=0 kwaye ilungu (2,1) yi-c(a+d)=0, kodwa ukuba b=c=0, ngoko a²=−1, okungenakwenzeka, ngoko enye ka-b no-c ayingu-0 ubuncinane, kwaye ngoko a+d kufuneka ibe ngu-0.
n-m-h1-mat-01.s.s2.because.model.1: a no-d ngamanani anezimpawu eziphikisanayo (isixa sabo ngu-0). Ukuba b no-c bobabini bengu-0, ngoko a isikwere kufuneka ibe yi-−1, kwaye akukho nani eliyinyani elinjalo, ngoko b okanye c ayingu-0, kwaye ngoko b(a+d)=0 okanye c(a+d)=0 inika a+d=0.

n-m-h1-mat-02.title: (AB)C no-A(BC): isiphumo esifanayo, kodwa ingaba isixa somsebenzi siyafana?
n-m-h1-mat-02.goal: Nangona ukudibanisa kunika isiphumo esifanayo, hlola ngokubala ukuphindaphinda ukuba inani lokubala linokwahluka ngokuxhomekeke kwindlela imveliso edityaniswe ngayo, uze uyile ubungakanani apho inani lokubala lahluka kakhulu.
n-m-h1-mat-02.material: Ukuphindaphinda imatrikhsi kudityanisa, (AB)C=A(BC), ngoko imatrikhsi yesiphumo iyafana nokuba ubala eyiphi imveliso kuqala. Kodwa ingaba isixa somsebenzi ekufuneka wenziwe siyafana? Ukuphindaphinda imatrikhsi ye-p×q (imiqolo p, iikholam q) ngemartrikhsi ye-q×r kunika imatrikhsi ye-p×r, kwaye ibhokisi nganye yesiphumo ifuna ukuphindaphinda q, ngoko kukho ukuphindaphinda p×q×r zonke. Vumela A ibe yimatrikhsi ye-p×q, B yimatrikhsi ye-q×r, kwaye C yimatrikhsi ye-r×s, ubale kuphela inani lokuphindaphinda (ungabali ukudibanisa).
n-m-h1-mat-02.thinking.0: Ukwahlula into yokuba iziphumo ziyafana kwinto yokuba iindleko zenkqubo ziyafana
n-m-h1-mat-02.thinking.1: Ukumisela ubungakanani njengezinto ezitshintshayo nokubhala iikhweshini ukuyila iimeko ezihlangabezana nemeko
n-m-h1-mat-02.thinking.2: Ukugqiba ulandelelwano lokubala ngokusekelwe kubungakanani beziphumo eziphakathi
n-m-h1-mat-02.prereq.0: Imeko yobungakanani yemveliso yemartrikhsi ukuba ichazwe
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s1.prompt: Xa A ingu-2×3, B ingu-3×4, kwaye C ingu-4×1, khetha ukuthelekisa okuchanekileyo kwenani lokuphindaphinda kweendlela ezimbini. ((AB)C ifumana i-AB kuqala emva koko iphindaphinda ngo-C; A(BC) ifumana i-BC kuqala emva koko iphindaphinda u-A ngayo.)
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwi-(AB)C, bhala ubungakanani be-AB eyenziwe kuqala, wongeze inani lokuphindaphinda kwimveliso yaloo AB no-C.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kwi-A(BC) nayo, bhala ubungakanani be-BC wongeze amanani amabini okuphindaphinda ngendlela efanayo.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s1.o.a: (AB)C ithatha ama-24 kwaye A(BC) ithatha ama-12, ngoko A(BC) incinci
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s1.r.a: Ibale kuphela ukuphindaphinda kokuqala kwindlela nganye. Kufuneka ubale nokuphindaphinda kwesibini (ukuphindaphinda imatrikhsi eseleyo esiphumeni).
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s1.o.b: (AB)C ithatha ali-18 kwaye A(BC) ithatha ama-32, ngoko (AB)C incinci
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s1.r.b: Amanani eendlela ezimbini atshintshiwe. Hlola kwakhona ubungakanani bemartrikhsi ephakathi eyenziwa yindlela nganye.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s1.o.c: (AB)C ithatha ama-32 kwaye A(BC) ithatha ali-18, ngoko A(BC) incinci
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s1.o.d: Iziphumo ziyafana, ngoko (AB)C no-A(BC) zithatha inani elifanayo lokuphindaphinda
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s1.r.d: Ithathe "imatrikhsi yesiphumo iyafana" ne-"isixa sokubala siyafana" njengesibakala esifanayo. Ukuba iimatrikhsi eziphakathi zinobungakanani obahlukileyo, amanani okuphindaphinda ayahluka nawo.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s1.explain: (AB)C: i-AB yi-2×4 kwaye ithatha ukuphindaphinda 2·3·4=24, emva koko (2×4)(4×1) ithatha 2·4·1=8, ngoko isixa ngama-32. A(BC): i-BC yi-3×1 kwaye ithatha 3·4·1=12, emva koko (2×3)(3×1) ithatha 2·3·1=6, ngoko isixa singali-18.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s2.prompt: Fumana uze ungenise amaseti amabini ahlukeneyo obungakanani p, q, r, s (nganye linani eliphelele elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-10) apho (AB)C ifuna ukuphindaphinda okuphindwe kabini okanye ngaphezulu kune-A(BC).
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala njengeekhweshini inani lokuphindaphinda le-(AB)C, p·q·r+p·r·s, nele-A(BC), q·r·s+p·q·s.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s2.hint.1: Faka amanani ambalwa uthelekise ukuba leyiphi ikhweshini ehla ngakumbi xa s incinci kakhulu.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s2.var.q: q (inani leekholam ze-A = inani lemiqolo ye-B)
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s2.var.r: r (inani leekholam ze-B = inani lemiqolo ye-C)
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Onke amanani amane ngamanani aphelele asuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-10.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Onke amanani amane kufuneka abe ngamanani aphelele asuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-10.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Inani lokuphindaphinda le-(AB)C liphindwe kabini okanye ngaphezulu kunelo le-A(BC).
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani lokuphindaphinda le-(AB)C lincinci kunamaxesha ama-2 elo le-A(BC).
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, ukuba p=3, q=3, r=9, s=1, ngoko (AB)C ithatha 81+27=108 kwaye A(BC) ithatha 27+9=36, ngoko ngamaxesha ama-3. I-(2,3,4,1) yenyathelo langaphambili inika ama-32 nali-18, ongafikeleli kumaxesha ama-2, kwaye kwi-(1,5,5,5), ngokuchasene, A(BC) ithatha ngaphezulu.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s3.prompt: Chaza ukuba kutheni amanani okuphindaphinda eyahluka nangona (AB)C no-A(BC) zinika isiphumo esifanayo. Emva koko khetha enye yobungakanani obuyingenise ngoku, ubhale ukuba leyiphi imveliso engcono ukuba ibalwe kuqala kobo bungakanani, unike ubungakanani bemartrikhsi ephakathi nesizathu sakho.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ubungakanani bemartrikhsi ephakathi eyenziwe kuqala yindlela nganye uzithelekise.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s3.hint.1: Fumana indlela inani leebhokisi kwimartrikhsi ephakathi elidibana ngayo nenani lokuphindaphinda.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba wahlule zombini ukuba iziphumo ziyafana nokuba izixa zokubala ziyahluka?
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba unike ubungakanani bemartrikhsi ephakathi njengobungqina?
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uchaze ulandelelwano owukhethileyo kubungakanani obuyingeniseyo kunye nobungakanani bemartrikhsi ephakathi?
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s3.model.0: Ngokudibanisa, imatrikhsi yesiphumo iyafana nokuba ubala eyiphi imveliso kuqala. Kodwa imatrikhsi ephakathi eyenziwe kuqala inobungakanani obahlukileyo, ngoko inani lokuphindaphinda liyahluka. Ukuba p=3, q=3, r=9, s=1, ngoko i-AB yi-3×9 enkulu, kodwa i-BC yi-3×1 encinci, ngoko A(BC), ephindaphinda i-BC kuqala, ithatha ama-36, incinci kakhulu kunama-108 e-(AB)C.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s3.model.1: Isiphumo siyafana, kodwa isixa sokubala siyahluka. Okukhona imatrikhsi ephakathi inkulu, kokukhona imveliso elandelayo ifuna ukuphindaphinda okuninzi, ngoko khetha indlela eyenza imatrikhsi ephakathi ibe ncinci, uphindaphinda B no-C kuqala (A(BC)).
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s3.model.2: (AB) iba yimatrikhsi enkulu, kodwa i-BC yimatrikhsi encinci enekholam enye kuphela. Ngoko A(BC) ingcono kuba ifuna ukuphindaphinda okuncinci.
n-m-h1-mat-02.s.s3.model.3: Isiphumo siyafana, kodwa amanani okuphindaphinda ayahluka. Ukuba C inekholam e-1, ukuphindaphinda i-BC kuqala ukwenza imatrikhsi ephakathi encinci kufuna ukuphindaphinda okuncinci.

n-m-h1-mat-03.title: Ukufumana k apho imatrikhsi echasayo ikho: ukuhlola isisombululo sika-Kyuri
n-m-h1-mat-03.topic: Iimatrikhsi: imeko yokuba imatrikhsi echasayo ikho, nonobumba k
n-m-h1-mat-03.goal: Thelekisa imeko (imatrikhsi echasayo ikho) nesalathiso sekhweshini ezisetyenziswe kwisisombululo, fumana ulungise impazamo, uze uhlole ngokufaka amaxabiso ubhale uluhlu olulungileyo.
n-m-h1-mat-03.material: U-Kyuri ufuna ukufumana amaxabiso eyinyani ka-k apho imatrikhsi A=[[k,3],[2,k+1]] inomchasayo. (Imatrikhsi ye-2×2 [[a,b],[c,d]] inomchasayo kuphela xa ad−bc ingelilo u-0. Imatrikhsi [[k,3],[2,k+1]] inomqolo wokuqala k, 3 nomqolo wesibini 2, k+1.) Isisombululo sika-Kyuri sinjalo.
n-m-h1-mat-03.thinking.0: Ukugcina isalathiso semeko (≠ okanye =) kuso sonke isisombululo
n-m-h1-mat-03.prereq.0: Imeko ad−bc≠0 yokuba imatrikhsi ye-2×2 ibe nomchasayo
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala kwisisombululo sika-Kyuri ongalunganga.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola enye enye ukuba umgca ngamnye ulandela ngokuvumelekileyo emgceni ongaphambili kwangoko.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s1.hint.1: Beka isimboli semeko esetwe kumgca wokuqala ecaleni kwesimboli yekhweshini esonjululwe emva koko, uzithelekise.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s1.line.0: Ukuze imatrikhsi echasayo ibekho, ad−bc≠0 iyafuneka.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s1.line.2: Ngoko k²+k−6=0 iyafuneka, kwaye ukusuka kwi-(k−2)(k+3)=0, k=2 okanye k=−3.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko amaxabiso ka-k esiwafunayo ngama-2 no-−3.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s1.explain: Umgca 3 ngumgca wokuqala ongalunganga. Umgca 1 uthi ad−bc≠0 iyafuneka, kodwa umgca 3 ufumana k apho ad−bc=0. Ukubala k²+k−6 kumgca 2 kuchanekile, kwaye umgca 4 ukopa nje isiphumo somgca 3.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa isisombululo sika-Kyuri uze ukhethe inkcazo echanekileyo kakhulu yoluhlu luka-k apho imatrikhsi echasayo ikho.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala fumana amaxabiso ka-k enza k²+k−6=(k−2)(k+3) ilingane no-0, emva koko ugwebe ukuba umchasayo ukho kula maxabiso.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s2.hint.1: Faka k=0, k=2, k=−3, kunye no-k=5, cwangcisa kwitheyibhile iimeko ezinomchasayo, uze uthelekise neenketho.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s2.r.a: Isonjululwe kusetyenziswa "okanye." Le meko isebenza nakwa-k=2 (kuba k≠−3 iyinyani), ngoko k=2 iyaquka. Ikhonektha ethetha ukuba zombini kufuneka zisilele yi-"kunye."
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s2.r.b: La ngamaxabiso apho ad−bc=0. Kula maxabiso akukho mchasayo. Itshintshe iimeko ezinomchasayo nezo zingenawo.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s2.r.d: Ilahlekelwe luphawu xa ifumana iingcambu ze-k²+k−6=0. Ixabiso lika-k elenza (k+3)=0 li-−3.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s2.explain: Akukho mchasayo kuphela kwa-k=2 nakwa-k=−3, apho ad−bc=(k−2)(k+3) ilingana no-0. Ngoko xa k linani eliyinyani elingelilo u-2 okanye u-−3, umchasayo ukho.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s3.prompt: Faka k=2 no-k=1 kwi-A ubale ixabiso le-ad−bc ukubonisa ukuba kutheni impendulo ka-Kyuri iphosisile. Emva koko bhala uluhlu olulungileyo luka-k kwisivakalisi esinye.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala imatrikhsi kwa-k=2 nakwa-k=1 nganye, ubale ad−bc.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s3.hint.1: Thi ngamagama leliphi kwiziphumo ezimbini elidibana ne-"umchasayo ukho."
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ufake amaxabiso omabini ubale ad−bc ngokwakho?
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe ixabiso elinika u-0 nelingenzi u-0 ngalinye lidibana njani nokuba umchasayo ukho?
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba k=2, ngoko ad−bc=2×3−3×2=0, ngoko akukho mchasayo. Ukuba k=1, ngoko ad−bc=1×2−3×2=−4, ongelilo u-0, ngoko umchasayo ukho. Ngoko u-2 no-−3 abafunyenwe ngu-Kyuri ngamaxabiso apho akukho mchasayo, kwaye impendulo echanekileyo yi-k≠2 kunye ne-k≠−3.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s3.model.1: Ukufaka k=2 kwenza ad−bc ilingane no-0, ngoko akukho mchasayo. Kwelinye icala, ukuba k=1, ngu-−4, ngoko umchasayo ukho. Ngoko u-2 no-−3 kufuneka bakhutshwe, kwaye impendulo ngamanani onke eyinyani ngaphandle kwe-2 ne-−3.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s3.model.2: Ukuba k=2, ad−bc ngu-0, ngoko akukho mchasayo, kwaye ukuba k=1, ngu-−4, ngoko umchasayo ukho. Ngoko u-2 no-−3 kufuneka basuswe.
n-m-h1-mat-03.s.s3.model.3: Ukufaka k=2 kunika ad−bc=0, kwaye ukufaka k=1 kunika u-−4. Ngoko k kufuneka ingabi ngu-2 okanye u-−3.

n-m-h1-mat-04.title: Isabelo semarike sitshintsha njani inyanga ngenyanga? Xa ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha
n-m-h1-mat-04.topic: Iimatrikhsi: utshintsho lwesabelo semarike nokuphindaphinda imatrikhsi okuphindaphindiweyo
n-m-h1-mat-04.goal: Ngomthetho wentshukumo obhalwe njengemartrikhsi, bala inyanga ngenyanga ukulungisa uqikelelo lwemvelo (ukukhula ngesixa esifanayo ixesha ngalinye), uze ufumane isabelo esingatshintshiyo usebenzisa ikhweshini.
n-m-h1-mat-04.material: Kukho abathwali bomnxeba ababini, 가 kunye 나. Ngenyanga e-1, i-90% yabathengi be-가 iyahlala kwaye i-10% iyashukuma iye ku-나. I-80% yabathengi be-나 iyahlala kwaye i-20% iyashukuma iye ku-가. Lo mthetho wentshukumo ufana qho ngenyanga. Ibhalwe njengemartrikhsi P=[[0.9, 0.1],[0.2, 0.8]], umqolo wokuqala unika izabelo ezisuka ku-가 ziye ku-(가, 나), kwaye umqolo wesibini ukusuka ku-나 uye ku-(가, 나). Izabelo zokuqala zi-60% ye-가 kunye ne-40% ye-나. Cinga ukuba inani eliphelele labathengi alitshintshi.
n-m-h1-mat-04.thinking.0: Ukufunda umthetho wentshukumo kwifom yetheyibhile nokubala inyanga e-1 kamva
n-m-h1-mat-04.thinking.1: Ukuvavanya uqikelelo olwandisa umkhwa ngokubala ngqo
n-m-h1-mat-04.prereq.0: Ukufunda ukuba imiqolo neekholam zemartrikhsi (itheyibhile) zimela ntoni
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha isigwebo ngokusekelwe kuphela koko uyaziyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bala ngokwahlukeneyo abantu abangena ku-가 nabantu abashiya baya ku-나.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba isabelo esifunyenwe kwinyathelo elidlulileyo siba yindawo yokuqala yokubala kwenyanga elandelayo.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Izabelo zokuqala zi-60% ye-가 kunye ne-40% ye-나. Umthetho wentshukumo ngu-P ofanayo nongentla.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Lithini isabelo se-가, nge-%, inyanga e-1 kamva?
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Abantu abahlala ne-가 yi-60%×0.9=54%, kwaye abo bavela ku-나 yi-40%×0.2=8%. Isixa yi-62%, kwaye i-나 yi-38%.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 70%: yongeza umlinganiselo wentshukumo we-10% ngqo kwi-60% yokuqala
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: I-10% etafileni lilinga lokushiya i-가 liye ku-나, kodwa lifundiwe njengokungena ku-가.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: 54%: bala kuphela abo bahlala ne-가, eyi-90% ye-60%
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ibale kuphela abo bahlala kwaye yashiya abantu abashukuma bevela ku-나 baya ku-가.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: 62%: yongeza abo bashukuma bevela ku-나 kwabo bahlala ne-가
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Esi sigwebo sibala zombini i-90% ye-60% ehlala ne-가 (54%) kunye ne-20% ye-40% evela ku-나 (8%).
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Izabelo emva kwenyanga e-1 zi-62% ye-가 kunye ne-38% ye-나. Umhlobo wakho uHayun uthe, "Inyuke ngamanqaku epesenti ama-2 kwinyanga e-1, ngoko emva kweenyanga ezi-2 iya kuba yi-64%."
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.1.after: I-64% ngqikelelo olufanelekileyo, kodwa alukhange luhlolwe. Inani labantu abashukumayo kwinyanga yesi-2 kufuneka libalwe kwakhona ukusuka kwi-62% nakwi-38%.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Mhlawumbi yi-64%: inyuke ngamanqaku epesenti ama-2 ukuza kuthi ga ngoku, ngoko cinga umkhwa ofanayo
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Iqhubekile nje utshintsho olubonwe ukuza kuthi ga ngoku. Kuyinto eqhelekileyo njengoqikelelo, kodwa ayikahlolwa.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Idinga ukuhlolwa: inani labantu abashukumayo lixhomekeke kwizabelo zenyanga leyo, ngoko bala kwakhona ukusuka kwi-62%
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ibone ukuba nangomthetho wentshukumo ofanayo, inani labantu abashukumayo lixhomekeke kwisabelo sokuqala senyanga leyo.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ayichanekanga: nje ukuba i-가 idlule kwi-62%, intshukumo iyayeka, ngoko ayikhuli ngakumbi
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Umthetho wentshukumo ufana qho ngenyanga. Intshukumo ayimi nje kuba isabelo sidlula elinye ixabiso.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ukubala inyanga yesi-2 ngomthetho ofanayo, isabelo se-가 yi-0.62×0.9+0.38×0.2=0.634, oko kukuthi, 63.4%. (UHayun uqikelele i-64%.)
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Sesiphi esona sizathu silungileyo sokuba i-63.4% ibe incinci kuno-64%?
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Nangona umthetho ufana, njengoko isahlulo sika-가 sikhula, abantu abaninzi bayasishiya 가, yaye njengoko isahlulo sika-나 sincipha, abantu abambalwa baphuma kwa-나. Ngoko ukonyuka kuya kuncipha.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Abantu abasuka kwa-가 baya kwa-나 bonyuke ukusuka kwi-6.0% ukuya kwi-6.2%, yaye abantu abasuka kwa-나 beza kwa-가 bancipha ukusuka kwi-8.0% ukuya kwi-7.6%
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kwinyanga yokuqala, i-0.6×0.1=6.0% kunye ne-0.4×0.2=8.0% zashukumisa, yaye kwinyanga yesibini, i-0.62×0.1=6.2% kunye ne-0.38×0.2=7.6% ziyashukuma. Ukonyuka okuyinetha kwehle ukusuka kwi-2.0 yamanqaku eepesenti ukuya kwi-1.4.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Abantu abasuka kwa-나 beza kwa-가 bonyuke ukusuka kwi-8.0% ukuya kwi-9.0%, yaye abantu abasuka kwa-가 baya kwa-나 bancipha ukusuka kwi-6.0% ukuya kwi-5.0%
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ezi azizizo ixabiso elabalwa ngokwenene. Ukuba ubala i-0.38×0.2 kunye ne-0.62×0.1 ngokuthe ngqo, ziyahluka.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kwezo nyanga zozibini i-6.0% kunye ne-8.0% zashukuma, yaye umahluko phakathi kwe-63.4% kunye ne-64% yimpazamo yokuyenza ibe ngqo
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kwinyanga yesibini izahlulo zatshintsha, ngoko inani labantu abashukumayo naso satshintsha. Umahluko awunakuchazwa ngokuyenza ibe ngqo.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni kwakubonakala ngathi ukonyuka kuya kuhlala kunjalo, kodwa nangona umthetho ufana, isahlulo sokuqala siyatshintsha inyanga nenyanga, ngoko inani labantu abashukumayo latshintsha. Kwimeko enje, apho imatrikhsi enye iphindaphindwa kaninzi, kufuneka usebenzise isiphumo sangaphambili njengendawo yokuqala yokubala okulandelayo.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s2.prompt: Emva kweenyanga ezininzi, izahlulo zinokufikelela kwimeko apho zingasatshintshi. Vumela isahlulo sika-가 ngelo xesha sibe yidesimali x (ngoko esika-나 yi-1−x), yaye umise ukulingana okuthi abantu abangena kwa-가 kwinyanga enye balingane nabo baphuma baya kwa-나, uze ufumane x.
n-m-h1-mat-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bonisa umlinganiselo ophuma kwa-가 uye kwa-나 kwinyanga enye usebenzisa x, kunye nomlinganiselo osuka kwa-나 uye kwa-가 usebenzisa 1−x.
