n-m-h1-logic-01.title: Ukufumana Umgca Wokuqala Ongalunganga Kwisisombululo Usebenzisa I-Contrapositive
n-m-h1-logic-01.goal: Kwisisombululo esifumana i-contrapositive yemeko edityaniswe ngo-"kwaye," fumana uze ulungise umgca wokuqala ongalunganga, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni isiphakamiso sokuqala singaguquki sibe ngamanga nangona i-contrapositive engachanekanga iyingamanga.
n-m-h1-logic-01.material: Esi sisisombululo sikaMinseo, esisebenzisa i-contrapositive ukumisela ukuba isiphakamiso "[Ukuba x>0 kwaye y>0, ngoko xy>0]" siyinyaniso okanye singamanga, kumanani okwenyani x, y. (I-xy ithetha i-x iphindaphindwe ngu-y.)
n-m-h1-logic-01.thinking.0: Ukulandela isisombululo umgca nomgca ukufumana indawo yokuqala apho iphosa khona
n-m-h1-logic-01.thinking.2: Ukulungisa ukuze ibe yi-contrapositive echanekileyo nokugweba ukuba isiphakamiso sokuqala siyinyaniso okanye asiyonyaniso
n-m-h1-logic-01.prereq.0: I-contrapositive ~q→~p yesiphakamiso p→q inexabiso lenyaniso elifanayo nesiphakamiso sokuqala
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo sikaMinseo.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.hint.0: Khangela ngokulandelelana ukuba umgca ngamnye ufike njani kumgca ongaphambi kwawo.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha i-(x, y) enye apho u-p ungabambi, uze ukhangele ukuba imeko ebhalwe njenge-~p kwisisombululo iyalingabalisa na eli xabiso.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.0: Masibe p: x>0 no-y>0, kwaye q: xy>0. Ngoko isiphakamiso esinikiweyo yi-p→q.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko ke i-contrapositive ithi "Ukuba xy≤0, ngoko x≤0 no-y≤0."
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.4: Ukuba x=−1, y=2, ngoko xy=−2≤0 kodwa y≤0 ayiyonyaniso, ngoko le contrapositive ayiyonyaniso.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.5: Isiphakamiso sokuqala ne-contrapositive yaso zinexabiso lenyaniso elifanayo, ngoko isiphakamiso esinikiweyo naso asiyonyaniso.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.explain: Ngumgca wesi-3. Ukuba p ithi "x>0 no-y>0," ngoko p ukungabambi kuthetha ukuba akunjalo ukuba zombini ziyipositivu, ngoko ithi "x≤0 okanye y≤0." "x≤0 no-y≤0" yimeko ecaphukayo kakhulu. Umgca wesi-4 ulandela owesi-3, nokubala komgca wesi-5 kuchanekile, kodwa isigqibo somgca wesi-6 sivela kwimposiso yomgca wesi-3.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.prompt: Bhala i-contrapositive echanekileyo, uze ngomgca omnye okanye emibini ubhale ukuba isiphakamiso esinikiweyo siyinyaniso okanye asiyonyaniso, nesizathu sakho.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ukuba zingaphi kwiimeko ezimbini x>0, y>0 ekufuneka zingabambi ukuze p ingabambi.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.hint.1: Faka amaxabiso afana no-x=−1, y=2 kwi-contrapositive yakho elungisiweyo, uze uzame amanani athile apositivu kwisiphakamiso sokuqala.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Xa ubhala i-contrapositive, ngaba ukhangele ngamaxabiso ukuba kutheni "kunye" kuguquka kube "okanye"?
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uchaze ukuba kutheni isiphakamiso sokuqala siyinyaniso usebenzisa inyani yokuba imveliso yamanani apositivu iyipositivu?
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uyaqonda ukuba kutheni isiphakamiso sokuqala singekho phosakeleyo nangona i-contrapositive engachanekanga ingeyonyaniso?
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.model.0: I-contrapositive echanekileyo ithi "Ukuba xy≤0, ngoko x≤0 okanye y≤0." Ukuba u-x no-y bobabini bapositivu, imveliso yabo nayo iyipositivu, ngoko isiphakamiso sokuqala siyinyaniso.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.model.1: ~p yi-x≤0 okanye y≤0, ngoko i-contrapositive ithi: ukuba xy≤0, ngoko x≤0 okanye y≤0. Imveliso yamanani amabini apositivu iyipositivu, ngoko isiphakamiso esinikiweyo siyinyaniso.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.model.2: ~p ithetha ukuba ubuncinane omnye kwi-x ne-y ulingana okanye mncinane kuno-0, ngoko i-contrapositive echanekileyo ithi "Ukuba xy≤0, ngoko x≤0 okanye y≤0." Imveliso yamanani amabini apositivu ihlala iyipositivu, ngoko isiphakamiso sokuqala siyinyaniso.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.prompt: Nangona umgca wesi-5 wabonisa ukuba i-contrapositive ebhalwe ngokungachanekanga ayiyonyaniso, isigqibo somgca wesi-6 siphosakele. Khetha esona sizathu sifanelekileyo.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.hint.0: Phinda ufunde phakathi kweziphi iziphakamiso ezibini kubamba ipropati yokuba "zinexabiso lenyaniso elifanayo."
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala isiphakamiso sikaMinseo ne-contrapositive echanekileyo icaleni ngecala, uthelekise ukuba siyafana na.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.a: Isiphakamiso sikaMinseo asiyiyo i-contrapositive, ngoko ukungabi yinyaniso kwaso akudluliselwa kwisiphakamiso sokuqala
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.b: Nokuba i-contrapositive ayiyonyaniso, isiphakamiso sokuqala sinokuba yinyaniso, ngoko akunakwenzeka ukugweba inyaniso okanye ubuxoki usebenzisa i-contrapositive
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.r.b: Uthathe i-contrapositive echanekileyo nesiphakamiso esibhalwe ngokungachanekanga njengezifanayo. I-contrapositive echanekileyo ihlala inexabiso lenyaniso elifanayo nesiphakamiso sokuqala.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.c: Umzekelo omnye ochasayo awunakubonisa ukuba nasiphi na isiphakamiso asiyonyaniso, ngoko ubungqina bomgca wesi-5 buburhabaxa
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.r.c: Ujongele phantsi indima yomzekelo ochasayo. Esi siphakamiso siba ngesiyonyaniso ngomzekelo omnye ochasayo.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.d: Isiphakamiso esijikisiweyo sesiphakamiso sokuqala nasona kufuneka sikhangelwe, ngoko i-contrapositive yodwa ayinakunika sigqibo
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.r.d: Uxubile isiphakamiso esijikisiweyo ne-contrapositive. Ixabiso lenyaniso lesiphakamiso sokuqala linikwa yi-contrapositive yodwa.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.explain: Yi-contrapositive echanekileyo kuphela enexabiso lenyaniso elifanayo nesiphakamiso sokuqala. Isiphakamiso sikaMinseo asiyiyo i-contrapositive, ngoko nokuba asiyonyaniso, asithethi nto ngesiphakamiso sokuqala. I-contrapositive echanekileyo ihlala inexabiso lenyaniso elifanayo nesokuqala, ngoko ungagweba usebenzisa i-contrapositive (kungenxa yoko b iphosakele), yaye umzekelo omnye ochasayo owaneleyo ukubonisa ukuba isiphakamiso esinesimo esithi "kuwo wonke ..." asiyonyaniso (c). Isiphakamiso esijikisiweyo sinokwahluka ngexabiso lenyaniso kwesokuqala, ngoko akukho mfuneko yokusikhangela (d).

n-m-h1-logic-04.title: Ukwenza Imeko Eyimfuneko Kodwa Engenelanga
n-m-h1-logic-04.goal: Funda "p yimeko eyimfuneko ye-q" njengobudlelwane bokuqulatha phakathi kweeseti zenyaniso, uze wakhe uze ukhangele imeko eyimfuneko kodwa engenelanga.
n-m-h1-logic-04.material: Kukho iimeko ezimbini kwinani lokwenyani x. q: −2≤x≤4. Kwaye kwizinto ezingatshintshiyo a no-b, p: a≤x≤b. Masibe iiseti zenyaniso zeemeko ezimbini zi-Q kunye ne-P, ngokulandelelana.
n-m-h1-logic-04.thinking.0: Ukuguqula isivakalisi sibe bubudlelwane bokuqulatha beeseti
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha ubudlelwane beeseti zenyaniso obuthetha okufanayo no-"p yimeko eyimfuneko ye-q."
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kwisivakalisi, qala ufumane ukuba yeyiphi efunekayo ukuba ibe yinyaniso: "ukuba q, ngoko p" okanye "ukuba p, ngoko q."
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.hint.1: Thatha ilungu leseti enye ulandele icala elifuneka ukuba likwiseti enye, kwi-P nakwi-Q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.r.a: Uyifundile njengobudlelwane apho "ukuba p, ngoko q" iyinyaniso, oko kukuthi apho p yimeko eyaneleyo.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.r.b: Uyifundile njengobudlelwane apho akukho xabiso lanelisa iimeko zombini. Imeko eyimfuneko bubudlelwane bokuqulatha.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.r.c: Uyifundile njengobudlelwane apho iimeko zombini ziyalingana. Ukuba yimfuneko akuthethi ukuba zombini kufuneka zilingane.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.explain: "p yimeko eyimfuneko ye-q" ithetha ukuba ukuba q iyabamba, ngoko p kufuneka ibambe, oko kukuthi q⇒p. Onke amalungu e-Q akwi-P, ngoko Q⊂P. Ukuba P⊂Q, ngoko p yimeko eyaneleyo ye-q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.prompt: Faka izibini ezintathu ezahlukeneyo zamanani aphelele a, b (−10≤a, b≤10) ezinje ngokuba p yimeko eyimfuneko kodwa ingeyiyo eyaneleyo ye-q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.hint.0: Zoba u-Q=[−2, 4] njengesithuba, uze unike isigqibo sokuba u-P=[a, b] kufuneka u-Q umgubungele njani.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.hint.1: Emva kokukhetha a no-b, fumana inani elinye lokwenyani elanelisa p kodwa lingalanelisi q, ukukhangela ukuba likhona ngokwenene.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b ngamanani aphelele ukusuka kwi-−10 ukuya kwi-10.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kufuneka babe ngamanani aphelele ukusuka kwi-−10 ukuya kwi-10.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Yonke i-x enelisa q ihlala inelisa p (imeko eyimfuneko).
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Enye i-x enelisa q ayinelisi p.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Kukho i-x enelisa p kodwa ingenelisi q (ngoko asiyonto eyaneleyo).
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.fail.c3: p no-q yimeko enye, ngoko p ikwayimeko eyaneleyo.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.explain: P=[a, b] kufuneka iqulathe u-Q=[−2, 4] ngaphandle kokulingana naye. Umzekelo, kwi-(−5, 6), P=[−5, 6], kwaye x=5 yanelisa p kodwa ayinelisi q. Kwi-(−2, 4), P=Q, ngoko p yimeko eyimfuneko neyaneleyo.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha esinye sezibini zakho (a, b) ubhale ① ixabiso elinye lika-x elanelisa p kodwa lingalanelisi q, no-② isizathu sokuba yonke i-x enelisa q ihlala inelisa p.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qala ubhale isithuba [a, b] usebenzisa amaxabiso akho ka-a no-b.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Khetha inani elinye elisesithubeni esi kodwa elingekho kwi-[−2, 4].
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ukhangele ukuba i-x oyikhethileyo ikwi-[a, b] ngokwenene kodwa ayikho kwi-[−2, 4]?
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uchaze ② usebenzisa inyani yokuba zombini iziphelo zika-Q, −2 no-4, zilele ngaphakathi kwa-P?
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Xa (a, b)=(−5, 6), x=5 yanelisa p kuba −5≤x≤6, kodwa inkulu kuno-4, ngoko ayinelisi q. Yonke i-x ene-−2≤x≤4 ilele phakathi kwe-−5 ne-6, ngoko nayo yanelisa p.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Ukuba ndithatha (−3, 4), ngoko x=−3 yanelisa p kodwa ayinelisi q. Uluhlu luka-q, [−2, 4], luqulathwe ngokupheleleyo kwi-[−3, 4], ngoko xa nje q iyabamba, p ihlala ibamba.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.model.2: Ukuba a=-3 no-b=5, ngoko u-5 wanelisa p kodwa akanelisi q. Onke amanani anelisa q alele phakathi kwe-−3 ne-5, ngoko naye anelisa p.

n-m-h1-comb-01.title: Ukuhlola isisombululo esibala iindlela zokubeka iileta kwiibhokisi zeposi
n-m-h1-comb-01.topic: Ukubala: amanyathelo omthetho wemveliso kufuneka asekelwe kwintoni?
n-m-h1-comb-01.goal: Kwisisombululo esisebenzise umthetho wemveliso, hlola ukuba “oko kunqunyiwe inyathelo ngenyathelo” kuyahambelana nemiqathango yengxaki, fumana umgca ongalunganga, uze uqinisekise ngokuchaza ngqo imeko encinci.
n-m-h1-comb-01.material: Sifuna ukubeka iileta ezi-4 ezahlukeneyo kwiibhokisi zeposi ezi-3, zonke. Ibhokisi yeposi inokufumana iileta ezininzi, kwaye enye ibhokisi yeposi ayinakufumana leta nayiphi na. USujin ayisombulule ngomthetho wemveliso njengoko kubonisiwe ngezantsi. (4³ linani olifumana ngokuphindaphinda i-4 amaxesha ama-3.)
n-m-h1-comb-01.thinking.2: Akha imiqathango yengxaki (zonke iileta ziyafakwa, iileta ezininzi ziyavunyelwa) kwintetho
n-m-h1-comb-01.prereq.1: Amava okubala iindlela zokubeka izinto ezahlukeneyo kwiindawo ezininzi usebenzisa umfanekiso womthi okanye uluhlu
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongalunganga kwisisombululo sikaSujin.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubeke umgca ngezantsi komqathango othi “zonke ziyafakwa” nothi “iileta ezininzi zingafakwa” kwingxaki.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca ngamnye, bhala ngokufutshane oko uSujin akunqumayo inyathelo ngenyathelo nokuba ukhetha kwintoni.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.hint.2: Hlola ukuba, ngezo zikhetho, zonke iileta ezi-4 ziyagqiba kwiibhokisi zeposi zingashiyiwe nanye.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.line.0: Ukubala iindlela usebenzisa umthetho wemveliso, sahlula umsebenzi ube ngamanyathelo.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.line.1: Siqala sijonge iibhokisi zeposi ezi-3 enye emva kwenye, kwaye kwibhokisi nganye sikhetha leta enye eza kubekwa kuyo kwiileta ezi-4.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.line.2: Kwibhokisi nganye kukho iindlela ezi-4 zokukhetha.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.line.3: Ekubeni kukho iibhokisi zeposi ezi-3, inani li-4×4×4=4³=64 iindlela.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.explain: Ngumgca we-2. Le ngxaki imalunga nokubeka “zonke iileta ezi-4” kwiibhokisi zeposi. Ukuba ukhetha leta enye nje kwibhokisi nganye, udibanisa iimeko apho ibhokisi enye ifumana iileta ezi-2 okanye enye leta ingafakwanga, ngoko awubali imeko esengxakini. Imigca ye-3 neye-4 ayilunganga kuba ilandela umgca we-2.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umgca ongalunganga ukufumana inani elichanekileyo leendlela, uze ubhale nokuba utshintshe ntoni ukunqumla inyathelo ngenyathelo.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bonisa inani eliphindaphindwayo nenani lamaxesha aliphindaphindwa kwintetho kaSujin.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bala ukuba zingaphi iibhokisi zeposi onokukhetha kuzo xa unquma leta enye, uze ubale amaxesha owenza ngawo oku.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.placeholder: umz. Ngeli xesha sinquma ... inyathelo ngenyathelo. Emva koko ...
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba utshintshele ekukhetheni ibhokisi yeposi kwileta nganye kwezi-4?
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubhale ngokuchanekileyo ukuba zingaphi iibhokisi zeposi onokukhetha kuzo xa ufaka leta enye?
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ungathi inani lokuphindaphinda kunye nenani eliphindaphindwayo yintoni?
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.model.0: Kwileta nganye kukho iibhokisi zeposi ezi-3 zokuyifaka, kwaye senza oku kwiileta ezi-4 enye emva kwenye, ngoko li-3×3×3×3=81 iindlela. USujin ubale ngebhokisi yeposi, ngoko akuphindanga kwahambelana nemiqathango.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s2.model.1: Leta nganye iya kwenye yeebhokisi zeposi ezi-3, ngoko kukho iindlela ezi-3^4=81. Ukuba ukhetha leta kwibhokisi nganye, umqathango wokuba zonke iileta ezi-4 ziyafakwa awakhiwanga kwintetho.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.prompt: Yeyiphi eyona ndlela ikhawulezayo yokuqinisekisa ukuba iindlela ezingama-64 zikaSujin ayiyiyo impendulo yengxaki?
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tshintshela kwimeko encinci, chaza yonke into ngqo, uze uthelekise eli nani nenani elibaliwe ngendlela kaSujin.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ukuba yeyiphi intetho enikwa yindlela kaSujin yeileta ezi-2 neebhokisi zeposi ezi-3.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.o.a: Hlola ukuba impendulo engama-64 linani lemvelo na.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.r.a: Ama-64 linani lemvelo, ngoko lidlula olu hlolo. Kodwa into yokuba ixabiso linani lemvelo ayikuxeleli ukuba indlela yokubala ichanekile na.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.o.b: Funda kwakhona ukuba zonke iileta ezi-4 zafakwa na.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.r.b: Ukufunda kwakhona imiqathango kulungile, kodwa akulolo vavanyo lunqumayo ukuba intetho ayilunganga.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.o.c: Chaza imeko encinci njengeleta ezi-2 neebhokisi zeposi ezi-3, uze uyithelekise nexabiso elibaliwe ngendlela kaSujin.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.o.d: Phindaphinda inani leebhokisi zeposi nenani leeleta uze uthelekise ne-4×3=12.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.r.d: Ukuthelekisa nentetho engenasiseko akunasiseko. Kufuneka uthelekise nexabiso olichaze ngqo.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s3.explain: Ukuba uchaza ngqo iileta ezi-2 (a, b) neebhokisi zeposi ezi-3, i-a inamacala ama-3 kwaye i-b inamacala ama-3, ngoko kukho iindlela ezi-9. Ukubala ngendlela kaSujin, kwibhokisi nganye yezi-3 ukhetha enye yeeleta ezi-2, oku kunika i-2³=8, eyahluka kwi-9. Ukuthelekisa imeko encinci ngolu hlobo kubonisa ngoko nangoko ukuba indlela ayilunganga.

n-m-h1-comb-04.title: Ukubala abahluli ngokwahlula ngamanani aphambili nokwenza inani elinabahluli abayi-12
n-m-h1-comb-04.topic: Umthetho wemveliso: ukubala abahluli ngokwahlula ngamanani aphambili
n-m-h1-comb-04.goal: Bona abahluli njengoko ukhetho lweziphindaphindi zamandla uze ubale ngomthetho wemveliso, uze wenze amanani anenani elinikiweyo labahluli uze uchaze ukuba kutheni iimo ezinokwenzeka zeziphindaphindi zamandla zinomda.
n-m-h1-comb-04.material: Cinga ukuba inani lendalo N linokwahlula ngamanani aphambili N=2^a×3^b (a, b zizinani eliphelele ubuncinane li-1). Abahluli bepozithivu be-N banefom ye-2^i×3^j kunye no-0≤i≤a, 0≤j≤b. Umzekelo, xa N=12=2²×3, abahluli bangu-1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12, okungabahluli abayi-6.
n-m-h1-comb-04.thinking.0: Bala ngokuguqula into ibe sisakhiwo (ukhetho lweziphindaphindi zamandla)
n-m-h1-comb-04.thinking.1: Qinisekisa ngokwenza imizekelo emininzi enelisa iimeko
n-m-h1-comb-04.thinking.2: Chaza indlela imeko yoluhlu (isiphindaphindi samandla ubuncinane li-1) inciphisa amathuba ngayo
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.prompt: Libinzana lini ku-a no-b elinika inani labahluli bepozithivu be-N=2^a×3^b? (Hlola ngemeko ye-12.)
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala bonke abahluli abayi-6 be-12 ngefom ye-2^i×3^j ubale izibini (i, j).
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ukukhetha i-i nokukhetha i-j kwenzeka kunye okanye ngokwahlukileyo.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.r.a: Kwi-12, a=2 kwaye b=1, ngoko a×b=2, kodwa eneneni kukho abahluli abayi-6.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.r.b: Kwi-12, a=2 kwaye b=1, ngoko a+b=3, kodwa eneneni kukho abahluli abayi-6.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.r.c: Ukufaka kwi-12 kunika i-3+2=5, kodwa eneneni kukho abahluli abayi-6. Cinga ukuba ukukhetha i-i no-j ngokwahlukileyo kunika isixa okanye imveliso.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s1.explain: Zikho iindlela ezi-a+1 zokukhetha i-i (ukusuka kwi-0 ukuya ku-a) neendlela ezi-b+1 zokukhetha i-j, kwaye umahluli umiselwa kuphela xa ukhetho lombini lwenziwa kunye, ngoko ngomthetho wemveliso kukho abahluli abangu-(a+1)(b+1). Kwi-12 oku yi-3×2=6, ehambelana.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.prompt: Fumana izibini ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo (a, b) ezinjalo ukuba N=2^a×3^b (a, b zizinani eliphelele ubuncinane li-1) inabahluli bepozithivu abayi-12 kanye, uze uzifake.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.hint.0: Hlula i-12 ibe yimveliso yamanani amabini ukuze ibinzana lenani labahluli ku-a no-b lilingane ne-12.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.hint.1: Thabatha i-1 kwinani ngalinye kula mabini ufumane a no-b, uze uhlole ukuba amaxabiso ahambelana noluhlu kwingxaki.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b zizinani eliphelele ubuncinane li-1.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kufuneka zibe zizinani eliphelele ubuncinane li-1.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s2.explain: Ukusuka kwi-(a+1)(b+1)=12, sinayo 12=2×6=3×4=4×3=6×2, ngoko (a, b)=(1, 5), (2, 3), (3, 2), (5, 1). Nge-12=1×12 esinye isiphindaphindi samandla sasiya kuba ngu-0, nto leyo engahambelani no-b≥1. Amanani ngu-2×3^5=486, 4×27=108, 8×9=72, 32×3=96.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.prompt: Xa N=2^a×3^b×5^c (a, b, c zonke zingu-1 ubuncinane) inabahluli bepozithivu abayi-12, (a+1)(b+1)(c+1)=12. Fumana onke amaxabiso anokwenzeka ka-a, b, c, uze ubhale isizathu sokuba akukho meko ilahlekileyo.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala bhala amaxabiso amancinci a+1, b+1, c+1 anokuwathatha.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa imveliso yamaxabiso amancinci kuphela ne-12.
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Xa ubhala i-12 njengemveliso, ingaba kuqala wanquma ukuba mangaphi amanani aphindaphindwayo?
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthe kutheni isibalo se-1 singenakusetyenziswa?
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ucinge nangeemeko ezinolandelelwano oluguqulweyo (a, b, c kwiindawo ezahlukileyo)?
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.model.0: a+1, b+1, c+1 zonke zizinani eliphelele ubuncinane li-2 kwaye imveliso yazo yi-12. Ukubhala i-12 njengemveliso yamanani amathathu ubuncinane li-2 kunika kuphela i-2×2×3, ngoko (a, b, c) zi-1, 1, 2 ngolandelelwano oluthile: (1,1,2), (1,2,1), (2,1,1).
n-m-h1-comb-04.s.s3.model.1: Isiphindaphindi samandla ngasinye si-1 ubuncinane, ngoko (a+1), (b+1), (c+1) azinakuba ngu-1 kwaye zingu-2 ubuncinane. Amanani amathathu apheleleyo kuphela angu-2 ubuncinane anemveliso ye-12 yi-2×2×3, ngoko iziphindaphindi zamandla zi-1, 1, 2, kwaye ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni lelinani eliphambili eliphi elifumana u-2, zikho iindlela ezi-3.

n-m-h1-comb-02.title: Ukupeyinta amacandelo amane ebhedi yeentyatyambo ngemibala emithathu: ngaba singalithemba ukuphindaphinda kukaHyunwoo?
n-m-h1-comb-02.topic: Ukubala: xa inani lezikhetho kumthetho wemveliso lixhomekeke kwizikhetho zangaphambili
n-m-h1-comb-02.goal: Qonda ukuba kumthetho wemveliso inani lezikhetho kwinyathelo ngalinye linokuxhomekeka kwizikhetho zangaphambili, uze ufumane inani elichanekileyo ngokwahlula kwiimeko.
n-m-h1-comb-02.material: Ibhedi yeentyatyambo esikwere yahlulwe yaba ngamacandelo amane: A, B, C, ne-D. I-A ne-B, i-B ne-C, i-C ne-D, kunye ne-D ne-A zabelana ngecala; i-A ne-C, kunye ne-B ne-D, zidibana kwichaphaza kuphela, ngoko azizizo izimelwane. Sisebenzisa imibala emi-3: bomvu, luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nokuthi mthubi, kwaye amacandelo asondeleneyo apeyintwa ngemibala eyahlukileyo. Umbala unokusetyenziswa kumacandelo amaninzi, kwaye akukho mfuneko yokusebenzisa yonke imibala emi-3. UHyunwoo ubale ngolu hlobo: I-A inendlela ezi-3, i-B yahluke kwi-A ngoko iindlela ezi-2, i-C yahluke kwi-B ngoko iindlela ezi-2, kwaye i-D yahluke kwi-C ngoko iindlela ezi-2, ngoko 3×2×2×2=24 iindlela.
n-m-h1-comb-02.thinking.0: Hlola ukuba inani lezikhetho liyafana na kwinyathelo ngalinye
n-m-h1-comb-02.prereq.1: Ukubala ngokwahlula kwiimeko usebenzisa umfanekiso womthi
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s1.prompt: Yenza iindlela ezi-4 ezahlukeneyo zokupeyinta ezanelisa imiqathango. Faka imibala njenge-1=bomvu, 2=luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, 3=mthubi.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s1.hint.0: Uqala ku-A, nquma imibala omnye ngomnye ngolandelelwano luka-B, C, D, uze uhlole ukuba akukho candelo linombala ofanayo nowomjikelezi walo.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qaphela ukuba i-D ngumjikelezi we-C kunye ne-A xa ubhala imizekelo yakho.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s1.ok.c1: Yonke imibala emine yenye phakathi kwe-1 ukuya ku-3.
n-m-h1-comb-02.s.s1.fail.c1: Umbala ngamnye kufuneka ube yenye ye-1, 2, 3 (inani eliphelele).

n-m-h1-eq-01.title: Ixabiso lika-√(−2)·√(−3): sesiphi kwezi zisombululo zimbini esichanekileyo?
n-m-h1-eq-01.topic: Amanani entsonkothileyo: ukuphindaphinda iingcambu zesikwere zamanani anegethivu nobubanzi apho umthetho wengcambu usebenza khona
n-m-h1-eq-01.goal: Jonga ngokubala amaxabiso ngqo ukuba umthetho wokuphindaphinda wee-radical ezimbini ungasetyenziswa njengoko injalo xa amanani asezantsi kwe-radical enegethivu, uze udibanise ngesivakalisi esinye ububanzi apho umthetho usebenza khona.
n-m-h1-eq-01.material:
USeonu noHaeun ngamnye wafumana ixabiso lika-√(−2)·√(−3).
Seonu: √(−2)·√(−3)=√((−2)×(−3))=√6
Haeun: √(−2)=√2·i, √(−3)=√3·i, ngoko √(−2)·√(−3)=√2·i·√3·i=√6·i²=−√6
(Apha √ ithetha ingcambu yesikwere, yaye siyavumelana ukuba ingcambu yesikwere yenani elinegethivu −k ngu-√(−k)=√k·i.)
n-m-h1-eq-01.thinking.0: Thelekisa imithetho esekelwe kuyo yonke isisombululo kwezi zimbini
n-m-h1-eq-01.thinking.1: Vavanya ukuba umthetho uyasebenza ngokutshintsha amanani
n-m-h1-eq-01.thinking.2: Dibanisa ngamazwi ububanzi apho umthetho usebenza khona
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.prompt: Jonga izisombululo ezibini uze ukhethe isigqibo esifanelekileyo kakhulu.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana apho inani elisezantsi kwe-radical linegethivu kwizisombululo ezibini, uze uthelekise ecaleni komnye indlela isisombululo ngasinye esiphathe ngayo eli nani linegethivu.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ulandela isivumelwano esiguqula u-√(−2) abe ngu-√2·i, bala ngqo ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ekugqibeleni uze unqume ukuba ixabiso lihambelana nesisombululo esiyiphi.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.a: Seonu: imveliso ye-radical inokudityaniswa ibe yinye, ngoko ixabiso ngu-√6
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.r.a: Wacinga ukuba √a·√b=√(ab) isebenza nokuba amanani anegethivu abandakanyekile. Jonga umva ukuba umthetho lo wenzelwe ntoni ngamanani a no-b.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.b: Ayinakunqunywa: ingcambu yesikwere yenani elinegethivu ayinalo ixabiso elinye
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.r.b: Kwisikolo samabanga aphakamileyo isivumelwano √(−k)=√k·i simisa ixabiso. Bala ngokwaso eso sivumelwano.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.c: Haeun: kuqala uguqulela kwiyunithi engeyonyani uze uphindaphinde, ngoko ixabiso ngu-−√6
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.d: Bobabini bachanekile: kuphela imilo eyahlukileyo yaye ixabiso liyafana
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.r.d: √6 no-−√6 ngamanani ahlukeneyo. Cinga ngento eyayiya kufuneka ukuze zilingane.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.explain: Ngokulandela isivumelwano √(−k)=√k·i, √(−2)·√(−3)=√2 i·√3 i=√6·i²=−√6. Isisombululo sikaSeonu sisebenzise √a·√b=√(ab) njengoko injalo nokuba a no-b zombini zinegethivu, ngoko siphume ku-√6.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.prompt: Khetha zonke ii-(a, b) apho √a·√b=√(ab) isebenza khona. (Bala iingcambu zesikwere zamanani anegethivu njenge-√(−k)=√k·i uze uthelekise macala omabini ngqo.)
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kwimeko nganye kwezine, bala icala langasekhohlo √a·√b nelangasekunene √(ab) ngokwahlukileyo uze uzibhale ecaleni komnye kwitheyibhile.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.hint.1: Hlula iimeko apho amaxabiso abaliweyo alingana kwezo ahlukileyo, uze ujonge imiqondiso ye-a no-b kwiimeko ezahlukileyo.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.r.a: Bala ngqo ukuba macala omabini alingana na. Xa yonke into engaphantsi kwee-radical iphozithivu, umthetho uyasebenza.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.r.b: √(−4)=2i no-√9=3, ngoko imveliso yi-6i, yaye √(−36)=6i. Umthetho uyasebenza nokuba omnye wazo unegethivu.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.r.c: √4=2 no-√(−9)=3i, ngoko imveliso yi-6i, yaye √(−36)=6i. Umthetho uyasebenza nokuba omnye wazo unegethivu.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.r.d: √(−4)·√(−9)=2i·3i=−6, kodwa √36=6, ngoko amaxabiso amabini ayahluka. Kule meko umthetho awusebenzi.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s2.explain: Kwi-a=4, b=9 iyasebenza njenge-6=6, kwaye kwi-a=−4, b=9 nakwi-a=4, b=−9 iyasebenza njenge-6i=6i kuzo zombini. Kuphela xa a=−4, b=−9 sifumana −6 no-6, ezahlukileyo.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.prompt: Bhala ngesivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini ukuba ngawaphi amanani a no-b apho ulinganiso √a·√b=√(ab) luphosisa khona, nokuba √a·√b no-√(ab) zinxulumene njani ngoko.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.hint.0: Khumbula imeko enye eyasilela kwinyathelo langaphambili uze ubhale imiqondiso ye-a no-b.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ixabiso langasekhohlo nelangasekunene kuloo meko uze uthelekise ukuba linxulumene njani.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.placeholder: Umzekelo: Kuphela xa a no-b zingu-... kunjalo ..., yaye ngoko ...
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubale imeko apho enye kuphela kwa-a okanye b enegethivu?
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ungathi xa zombini zinegethivu umqondiso utshintsha ngenxa ye-i²=−1?
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.model.0: Iphosisa kuphela xa a no-b zombini zinegethivu. Emva koko √a·√b inomqondiso ochaseneyo no-√(ab), ngoko iba ngu-−√(ab).
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba omabini amanani anegethivu, √a·√b=√|a|i·√|b|i=−√(ab), ngoko umqondiso uchasene. Iyasebenza ukuba lunye kuphela olunegethivu okanye ukuba zombini ziphozithivu.

n-m-h1-eq-02.material: UChaerin wazama ukufumana ixabiso le-ω^2026 xa ω yenye yeengcambu ezingeyonyani zolinganiso lwekhwadratikhi x²−x+1=0, wasombulula ngolu hlobo lulandelayo. (ω^2026 ithetha ω kumandla angama-2026.)

n-m-h1-eq-02.prereq.1: Iifomyula zokwahlula zibe zizinto kunye nokubala kwezichazi

n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s1.explain: Umgca 4 awulunganga. Umgca 1 uthe ω³=−1, ngoko (ω³)^675=(−1)^675=−1. Ngoko ω^2026=−ω. Imigca 1 ukuya kwi-3 ichanekile.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ixabiso elilungisiweyo le-ω^2026, ubonise ukuba enye indlela (umzekelo, usebenzisa ixabiso le-ω⁶ nentsalela xa wahlula ngo-6) inika ixabiso elifanayo.

n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ukuba ω³=−1, fumana ixabiso le-ω⁶, uze ubale kwakhona usebenzisa intsalela xa i-2026 yahlulwa ngalo mchazi.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ugqibe uphawu lwe-(−1)^675 ngenxa yokuba isichazi singumangqabangqaba?

n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.model.0: ω^2026=−ω. Kuba ω³=−1, (ω³)^675=(−1)^675=−1. Ngenye indlela, ω⁶=1 kwaye 2026=6×337+4, ngoko ω^2026=ω⁴=ω³·ω=−ω, efanayo.

n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.hint.1: Fumana isichazi sokuqala apho ixabiso liba li-1, uze uhlole ukuba liyafana kwizichazi ezisisiphindaphindi salo.

n-m-h1-eq-03.title: Ukuba ingcambu enye yi-1+i, ingaba enye yi-1−i?
n-m-h1-eq-03.topic: Iingcambu ezingeyonyani zeekhweshini zequadratic: imeko eqinisekisa ingcambu edibeneyo
n-m-h1-eq-03.goal: Chonga ukuba loluphi ulwazi olufunekayo ukumisela enye ingcambu xa enye ingeyonyani, uze wenze umzekelo apho isigqibo sitshintsha ukuba olo lwazi alukho.
n-m-h1-eq-03.material: Masithi ingcambu enye ye-x²+px+q=0 yi-1+i. U-Soyeon wathi, "Enye ingcambu kufuneka ibe yi-1−i," kwaye uJeonghun wathi, "Awukwazi ukubhengeza oko." (Akukaziwa ukuba p no-q ngamanani ani.)

n-m-h1-eq-03.thinking.1: Yenza umzekelo ochasayo ngokwakho uze uwuhlole
n-m-h1-eq-03.thinking.2: Chaza ukuba kutheni umzekelo ochasayo ubonisa ukuba imeko iyafuneka
n-m-h1-eq-03.prereq.0: Ubudlelwane phakathi kweengcambu ezimbini neekoyifishenti zekhweshini yequadratic
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.prompt: Ukuze isibakala sika-Soyeon sibe nyaniso ngokuqinisekileyo, ngowuphi kule ilandelayo owanele ukuwazi?
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.hint.0: Vumela enye ingcambu ibe yi-a+bi ubhale isixa nemveliso yeengcambu ezimbini ngo-a no-b ngqo.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuba imeko kwinketho nganye inika yiphi ikhweshini kwa-a no-b, uze ukhangele imeko ayanelisa ngelixa a+bi ingeyiyo i-1−i.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba awukwazi ukuba p no-q bayinyani na, p²−4q inokuba linani elintsonkothileyo, ngoko igama "ithabatha" ngokwalo linokungachazwa nokuba.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.r.b: Nokuba isixa siyinyani, enye ingcambu inokungabi yi-1−i. Vumela enye ingcambu ibe yi-a+bi uphonononge inxalenye engeyonyani yesixa.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.r.c: Nokuba imveliso iyinyani, enye ingcambu inokungabi yi-1−i. Vumela enye ingcambu ibe yi-a+bi uphonononge inxalenye engeyonyani yemveliso.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.explain: Kuphela xa p no-q zombini beyinyani inani elintsonkothileyo elidibeneyo liyingcambu. Ukuba nesixa esiyinyani kuphela, okanye imveliso eyinyani kuphela, akwanelanga. Ukuba zombini ziyinyani, yimeko apho p no-q beyinyani, kwaye isigqibo siyamiselwa.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.prompt: Vumela enye ingcambu ibe yi-a+bi (a, b ngamanani aphelele asuka kwi-−9 ukuya kwi-9). Ngenisa iibini ezintathu ezahlukeneyo (a, b) ezinesixa seengcambu ezimbini esiyinyani kwaye enye ingcambu ingeyiyo i-1−i.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala inxalenye eyinyani neyengeyonyani yesixa (1+i)+(a+bi) ngo-a no-b.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.hint.1: Gqiba ukuba yeyiphi inxalenye ekufuneka ibe ngu-0 ukuze isixa siyinyani, uze uhlole ngokutshintsha ixabiso lika-a phantsi kwaloo meko.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b ngamanani aphelele ngaphakathi koluhlu.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kufuneka babe ngamanani aphelele asuka kwi-−9 ukuya kwi-9.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Inxalenye engeyonyani yesixa seengcambu ezimbini ngu-0, ngoko isixa siyinyani.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Isixa (1+a)+(1+b)i asiyonyani. Zama ukwenza inxalenye engeyonyani yesixa ibe ngu-0.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Enye ingcambu iyavela ibe yi-1−i. Kufuneka ufumane imeko eyahlukileyo kwisibakala sika-Soyeon.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.explain: Ukuze isixa siyinyani, inxalenye engeyonyani 1+b kufuneka ibe ngu-0, ngoko b=−1, kwaye ukuba a ayingu-1, enye ingcambu ayiyi-1−i. Umzekelo, ukuba iingcambu zi-1+i kunye ne-3−i, isixa singu-4, esiyinyani, kodwa enye ingcambu ayiyi-1−i.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.prompt: Jonga ikhweshini enezingcambu 1+i kunye ne-3−i: isixa siyinyani, kodwa isibakala sika-Soyeon asisebenzi. Bala nemveliso yeengcambu ezimbini, ubhale ukuba kutheni le khweshini ingumzekelo ochasayo wesibakala sika-Soyeon.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.hint.0: Andisa i-(1+i)(3−i) usebenzisa umthetho wokusasazwa uyenze lula ngokufaka u-−1 endaweni ye-i².
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa into yokuba p no-q bamiselwa sisixa nemveliso yeengcambu ezimbini, uze uhlole ukuba p no-q bayinyani na.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba wandise i-(1+i)(3−i) ngqo waqinisekisa ukuba inxalenye engeyonyani iyashiyeka?
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe ikhweshini yomzekelo ochasayo iyayiphula imeko efunwa sisibakala sika-Soyeon?
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.model.0: (1+i)(3−i)=3−i+3i−i²=4+2i, ngoko imveliso ayiyonyani. Kuba imveliso q ayiyonyani, p no-q abayinyani bobabini, ngoko imeko efunwa sisibakala sika-Soyeon ayanelisiwe.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.model.1: Isixa singu-4, esiyinyani, kodwa imveliso yi-4+2i, enenxalenye engeyonyani kwaye ayiyonyani. Iikoyifishenti zale khweshini azizizonke ziyinyani, ngoko ngaphandle kwemeko yokuba iikoyifishenti ziyinyani, asikwazi ukuthi enye ingcambu yi-1−i.

n-m-h1-eq-04.title: Ukwenza ikhweshini x⁴+ax²+b=0 enex=2 njengengcambu
n-m-h1-eq-04.topic: Iikhweshini zesidanga esiphezulu: iikhweshini ze-biquadratic nemeko yeengcambu eziyinyani emva kokufaka endaweni
n-m-h1-eq-04.goal: Gqiba ukuba ziziphi iingcambu zekhweshini yequadratic efunyenwe nge-x²=t ezinika iingcambu eziyinyani zekhweshini yokuqala, yenza iikhweshini ezininzi ezihambelana neemeko, uze uchaze isizathu.
n-m-h1-eq-04.material: Kukho ikhweshini x⁴+ax²+b=0 (a, b ngamanani aphelele). Phakathi kweengcambu zayo ezine (bala ingcambu ephindaphindiweyo ngobuninzi), sifuna ezimbini kanye zibe ziyinyani nezimbini ezinye zingeyonyani. Kwakhona, x=2 yingcambu yale khweshini.
n-m-h1-eq-04.thinking.2: Chaza ukuba kutheni uphawu lweekoyifishenti lugqiba uhlobo lweengcambu
n-m-h1-eq-04.prereq.1: Ubudlelwane phakathi kweengcambu neekoyifishenti zekhweshini yequadratic
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.prompt: Ukumisela x²=t kunika t²+at+b=0. Ukuze x kwikhweshini yokuqala ibe yinyani, t kufuneka ithabathe amaxabiso athini?
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.hint.0: Sombulula x²=t kwiimeko ezintathu t=4, t=0, t=−4 uze uhlole ukuba x iyinyani na.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ngoluhlu lwamaxabiso ohlala ulifumana xa wenza inani eliyinyani x isikwere.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.o.a: Kwanele ukuba t libe linani eliphelele
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.r.a: Ngo-x=√t, nokuba t linani eliphelele, x ayiyonyani xa t ithabatha. Okubalulekileyo luphawu, hayi ukuba linani eliphelele.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.o.b: Kwanele ukuba t libe linani eliyinyani
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.r.b: Nokuba t iyinyani, xa ithabatha akukho x eyinyani ene-x²=t. Zama ukusombulula x²=−4 kwa-t=−4.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.o.c: t linani eliyinyani eliyi-0 okanye ngaphezulu
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.r.d: Nokuba t ingu-0, x=0 yingcambu eyinyani, kwaye nokuba t ayilolinani eliphelele, iingcambu eziyinyani ziyavela. Imeko imxinwa kakhulu.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.explain: Ukuba x iyinyani, x²=t yi-0 okanye ngaphezulu. Ngokuchasene, ukuba t linani eliyinyani eliyi-0 okanye ngaphezulu, ngoko x=±√t ziingcambu eziyinyani. Ukuba t ithabatha, x iba lijoyina lamanani angeyonyani adibeneyo omnye komnye.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.prompt: Fumana iibini ezintathu ezahlukeneyo zamanani aphelele (a, b) zekhweshini x⁴+ax²+b=0 ukuze x=2 ibe yingcambu, ezimbini kanye kwiingcambu ezine ziyinyani (2 no-−2), kwaye ezimbini ezinye zingeyonyani. (−20≤a≤20)
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.hint.0: Faka x=2 ukufumana ubudlelwane obunye phakathi kuka-a no-b, uze ukhethe a, ufumane b, uze ufumane iingcambu ezimbini zika-t²+at+b=0 ngqo.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.hint.1: Enye yeengcambu ezimbini zika-t ngu-4. Jonga ukuba iingcambu zekhweshini yokuqala ziba yintoni xa enye ingcambu ibonakalisa ngokongeza, ingu-0, okanye ithabatha.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kufuneka babe ngamanani aphelele anomda −20≤a≤20.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukufaka x=2 akunikanga u-0. Hlola ixabiso le-16+4a+b.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Enye kuphela yeengcambu ezimbini zika-t ebonakalisa ngokongeza.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Akukho ngcambu ziyinyani ezimbini (zonke ezine ziyinyani, okanye u-0 yingcambu). Phonononga iimpawu zeengcambu ezimbini zekhweshini yequadratic ka-t.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.explain: Ukuba x=2, ngoko t=4 yingcambu ye-t²+at+b=0, ngoko 16+4a+b=0. Enye t yi-−a−4, kwaye eli xabiso kufuneka lithabathe, ngoko b=4(−a−4)<0. Umzekelo, (a, b)=(−3, −4) inika (t−4)(t+1)=0, ngoko x=±2, ±i.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Usebenzisa into yokuba imveliso yeengcambu ezimbini zekhweshini yequadratic ka-t yi-b, chaza ukuba kutheni, xa b<0, ikhweshini yokuqala inezingcambu eziyinyani ezimbini kanye.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Vumela iingcambu ezimbini zika-t²+at+b=0 zibe nguye t₁, t₂, ubhale t₁t₂ njenge-b, uze ucinge ngeempawu zeengcambu ezimbini xa b ithabatha.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bhala ukuba x iba yintoni xa usombulula x²=t kwa-t ebonakalisa ngokongeza nakwa-t ethabathayo.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.placeholder: umz. Kuba imveliso yeengcambu ezimbini zika-t yi-b, ...
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uqinisekisile ukuba lowo ubonakalisa ngokongeza kumaxabiso amabini ka-t unika x=±√t?
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uqinisekisile ukuba x iba ngeyonyani kwithabathayo?
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Imveliso yeengcambu ezimbini zika-t yi-b kwaye b<0, ngoko iingcambu ezimbini zinezimpawu eziphikisanayo, enye ibonakalisa ngokongeza nenye ithabatha. t ebonakalisa ngokongeza inika x=±√t, iingcambu ezimbini eziyinyani, kwaye t ethabathayo yenza x ibe ngeyonyani.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Ngobudlelwane phakathi kweengcambu neekoyifishenti, imveliso yamaxabiso amabini ka-t yi-b, ngoko ukuba b ithabatha, enye t ibonakalisa ngokongeza kwaye enye ithabatha. Kuphela t ebonakalisa ngokongeza inika x eyinyani kwaye t ethabathayo inika iingcambu ezingeyonyani, ngoko zikho iingcambu eziyinyani ezimbini kanye.

n-m-h1-eq-08.prereq.0: Ubudlelwane phakathi kweengcambu neekoyifishenti zekhweshini yequadratic
n-m-h1-eq-08.title: Isisombululo esifumana i-k kwimveliso yeengcambu ezi-3: ngaba uphawu lulunge?
n-m-h1-eq-08.topic: Ukulingana kwamanqanaba aphezulu: iimpawu kubudlelwane beengcambu nee-coefficient zokulingana kwekyubhiki
n-m-h1-eq-08.goal: Fumana uze ulungise umgca ongalunganga kubudlelwane beengcambu nee-coefficient zokulingana kwekyubhiki, uze uhlole uphawu lobudlelwane obubanzi usebenzisa ukulingana kunezingcambu ezikhethekileyo.
n-m-h1-eq-08.material: Esi sisisombululo sikaHajun sokufumana ixabiso le-constant k xa iingcambu ezi-3 ze-x³−2x²−5x+k=0 zi-α, β, γ kwaye imveliso yeengcambu ezi-3 αβγ ingu-−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.thinking.2: Hlola iimpawu zefomyula ebanzi ngomzekelo othe ngqo
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongalunganga kwisisombululo sikaHajun.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuba ilungu elingatshintshiyo liba yintoni xa wandisa (x−α)(x−β)(x−γ).
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba uphawu lwelungu elingatshintshiyo lufana okanye luphikisana nemveliso yeengcambu ezi-3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.line.0: Vuma ukuba iingcambu ezi-3 ze-x³−2x²−5x+k=0 zi-α, β, γ.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.line.1: Ngobudlelwane beengcambu nee-coefficient, imveliso yeengcambu ezi-3 lilungu elingatshintshiyo k elahlulwe yi-coefficient ephambili engu-1, ngoko αβγ=k.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.explain: Umgca we-2 awulunganga. Kwindlela yokulingana kwekyubhiki, imveliso yeengcambu ezi-3 yi-−(ilungu elingatshintshiyo)÷(coefficient ephambili), ngoko αβγ=−k. Ngoko −k=−6 inika k=6. Imigca ye-3 neye-4 ngamanani alandela umgca we-2.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ixabiso le-k elichanekisiweyo, uze ubhale inkqubo yokuhlola ukuba imveliso yeengcambu ezi-3 ngenene yi-−6 kuloo k, ngokwahlula ukulingana okanye ngokufaka ingcambu endaweni.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.hint.0: Lungisa umgca ongalunganga uze ufumane i-k kwakhona, emva koko bhala ukulingana nale k uze ufumane inani elinye eliphelele eliyingcambu.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.hint.1: Emva kokufumana ingcambu enye, hlula ukufumana ezinye iingcambu uze uphindaphinde iingcambu ezi-3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Xa k=6, ngaba uhlule i-x³−2x²−5x+6 wafumana iingcambu ezi-3?
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uphindaphinde iingcambu ezi-3 ngqo uhlole ukuba ufumana u-−6?
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.model.0: αβγ=−k, ngoko −k=−6 inika k=6. Ukuhlola: x³−2x²−5x+6=(x−1)(x−3)(x+2), ngoko iingcambu ezi-3 zi-1, 3, −2 kwaye imveliso yi-1×3×(−2)=−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.model.1: Uphawu lwelungu elingatshintshiyo luphikisana, ngoko imveliso yeengcambu ezi-3 yi-−k. Ngoko k=6, kwaye ukufaka x=1 endaweni kunika 1−2−5+6=0, ngoko yingcambu. Ukuyibhala njenge-(x−1)(x−3)(x+2), imveliso yeengcambu ezi-3 yi-1·3·(−2)=−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.model.2: k=6. x³−2x²−5x+6=(x−1)(x−3)(x+2), ngoko iingcambu zi-1, 3, −2 kwaye imveliso yi-−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.prompt: Khetha ubudlelwane obuchanekileyo xa iingcambu ezi-3 ze-x³+ax²+bx+c=0 zi-α, β, γ.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukulingana kwekyubhiki kunezingcambu 1, 2, 3 njenge-(x−1)(x−2)(x−3)=0, kwandise, uze ufumane i-a, b, c.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.hint.1: Faka i-a, b, c oyifumeneyo kwintetho kukhetho ngalunye uze ufumane leyo ihambelana nesixa nemveliso yeengcambu ezi-3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.r.b: Ufunde ii-coefficient njengoko zinjalo. Thelekisa isixa esi-6 nexabiso le-a xa iingcambu ezi-3 zi-1, 2, 3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.r.c: Udibanise iimpawu zesibini nezesithathu neempawu zokulingana kwesikwere. Bala amaxabiso e-b ne-c xa iingcambu zi-1, 2, 3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.r.d: Awutshintshanga uphawu lwesixa. Fumana ixabiso le-a xa iingcambu zi-1, 2, 3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.explain: (x−1)(x−2)(x−3)=x³−6x²+11x−6, ngoko a=−6, b=11, c=−6. Isixa esi-6=−a, isixa semveliso yeengcambu ezi-2 i-11=b, kwaye imveliso engu-6=−c.

n-m-h1-eq-06.title: Ukubhala kwakhona “akukho zingcambu ukuba D<0” ukuze kulungele abaphulaphuli
n-m-h1-eq-06.topic: Idiskhriminanti yokulingana kwesikwere: ukwahlula “akukho zingcambu zokwenyani” kuka “akukho zingcambu”
n-m-h1-eq-06.goal: Bhala kwakhona isitatimenti ngediskhriminanti ngokuchanekileyo kubaphulaphuli (umntakwenu osebangeni le-9, ofunda naye), uze ufumane indawo apho amagama angaxeliyo inkqubo yamanani adala ukungaqondani.
n-m-h1-eq-06.material: UGyumin ubhale amanqaku aphambili ngediskhriminanti kwincwadi yamanqaku ukuchazela umntakwabo osebangeni le-9 ngeengcambu zokulingana kwesikwere. (I-a, b, c ngamanani okwenyani kwaye a≠0.)
n-m-h1-eq-06.thinking.1: Bhala umxholo ofanayo ngamagama ahlukeneyo ukuze ulungele abaphulaphuli
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca kwincwadi yamanqaku kaGyumin ongachanekanga.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuba yeyiphi inkqubo yamanani umgca ngamnye uyicingayo.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.hint.1: Thatha ukulingana kwe-D engeyiyo ethe-kratya njenge-x²+1=0, uze ucinge ukuba ngenene ayinazisombululo kwaphela na.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.line.1: Ukuba D>0, inezingcambu ezi-2 zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.explain: Umgca we-3 awuchanekanga. Ukuba D<0 akukho zingcambu zokwenyani, kodwa kwisikolo samabanga aphezulu amanani andiswa abe ngamanani entsonkothileyo, kwaye ukulingana kunezingcambu ezi-2 ezingeyonyani eziyi-conjugates enye yenye. Imigca ye-1, 2, kunye ne-4 ichanekile.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.prompt: Bhala kwakhona umgca we-3 ngesivakalisi esinye okanye ezi-2 ukuze umntakwenu osebangeni le-9 aqonde. (Akazifundanga okwangoku iinombolo ezingeyonyani, kodwa uyazazi igrafu.)
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuba “akukho zingcambu” kwathethwa kuyiphi inkqubo yamanani, uze ufake eso sithuba kwisivakalisi.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.hint.1: Khumbula ukuba iingcambu zokulingana zivela phi kwigrafu uze uqhagamshele oko kwisivakalisi.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Endaweni yokubhala “akukho zingcambu” njengoko injalo, ngaba uxele ukuba uthetha yiphi inkqubo yamanani?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uchaze usebenzisa ingcamango yegrafu eyaziwa ngumntakwenu?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba D<0, akukho zingcambu phakathi kwamanani okwenyani. Igrafu (iparabola) ayidibani ne-x-eksisi. Ukuba sandisa kumanani abizwa ngokuba ziinombolo ezingeyonyani, iingcambu ziyavela, kodwa uza kuzifunda oko kamva.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba D<0, akukho zingcambu zokwenyani. Oku kuthetha ukuba igrafu ye-y=ax²+bx+c ayidibani ne-x-eksisi. Kwisikolo samabanga aphezulu, xa amanani andiswa, olunye uhlobo lwengcambu luyavela.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.prompt: Ngeli xesha, bhala kwakhona umgca ofanayo we-3 ngamagama achanekileyo kwinqaku elifundwa ngumhlobo osebangeni le-10. (Bhala inani nohlobo lweengcambu.)
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kwisivakalisi somntakwenu osebangeni le-9, “oko uza kukufunda ngokulandelayo” kushiyiwe. Ngeli xesha, kubhale ngqo.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuba zingaphi iingcambu ezingeyonyani nokuba ezi-2 ezingeyonyani zinxulumene njani, usebenzisa izisombululo ze-x²+1=0 njengesalathiso.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale ukuba zingaphi iingcambu ezingeyonyani nokuba zinxulumene njani?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngokungafaniyo nenkcazelo yebanga le-9, ngaba wandise inkqubo yamanani yaya kumanani entsonkothileyo?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba D<0, akukho zingcambu zokwenyani, kwaye kukho iingcambu ezi-2 ezahlukeneyo ezingeyonyani eziyi-conjugates enye yenye.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba D<0, akukho zingcambu zokwenyani, kodwa kumanani entsonkothileyo kukho iingcambu ezi-2 ezingeyonyani. Iingcambu ezi-2 zii-complex conjugates enye yenye.

n-m-h1-eq-07.title: Ukwenza izibini zesikhuphi ngo-i^p+i^q=0
n-m-h1-eq-07.topic: Amanani entsonkothileyo: amandla eyunithi engeyonyani i kunye nemeko yesixa esingu-0
n-m-h1-eq-07.goal: Sebenzisa ipatheni ephindaphindayo kumandla e-i ukwenza ngokwakho izibini zesikhuphi ezinesixa esingu-0, uze ushwankathele ngamagama oko ezo zibini zinako ngokufanayo.
n-m-h1-eq-07.material: Iyunithi engeyonyani i yanelisa i²=−1. Ukuthatha amandla e-i kunika i, i²=−1, i³, i⁴, …, kwaye ukuba ubhala amaxabiso ngolandelelwano, amaxabiso afanayo ayaphindaphinda. Qwalasela i^p+i^q kumanani emvelo p, q. (I^p ithetha i ngamandla ayi-p.)
n-m-h1-eq-07.thinking.0: Fumana ipatheni apho amandla aphindaphinda khona
n-m-h1-eq-07.thinking.2: Yenza ngokubanzi uze uchaze oko imizekelo oyenzileyo ineyona nto ifanayo
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.hint.0: Bala i¹, i², i³, i⁴, i⁵, i⁶ ngolandelelwano uze ubhale ukuba amaxabiso aqhubeka njani.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana isikhuphi apho amaxabiso aqala ukuphindaphinda khona, uze ufumane intsalela xa i-2025 yahlulwa ngalo nani.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.r.b: I-i²=−1 lixabiso xa isikhuphi singu-2. Jonga ukuba yintoni intsalela xa i-2025 yahlulwa ngo-4.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.r.c: I-i³=−i yile xa intsalela yesikhuphi esahlulwe nge-4 ingu-3. Fumana intsalela xa i-2025 yahlulwa nge-4.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.r.d: I-i⁴=1 yile xa isikhuphi siyisiphindaphindi se-4. Hlola intsalela xa i-2025 yahlulwa nge-4.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.explain: I-i, −1, −i, 1 ziyaphindaphinda ngamaqela e-4. Intsalela xa i-2025 yahlulwa nge-4 yi-1, ngoko i²⁰²⁵=i¹=i.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izibini ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo (p, q) zamanani emvelo (1≤p, q≤40) ezinjalo ukuba i^p+i^q=0, uze uzifake.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala amaxabiso e-i¹ ukuya kwi-i⁸ uze ufumane izibini zamaxabiso amabini isixa sawo singu-0.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.hint.1: Emva kokufumana isibini, linga ukuba ukwandisa izikhuphi nge-4 kunika amaxabiso afanayo, uze utshintshe izikhuphi ukwenza izibini ezintsha.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.fail.c1: I-p ne-q kufuneka zibe zizinani lemvelo ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-40.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.ok.c2: I-i^p ne-i^q ziziphikisi, ngoko isixa singu-0.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.fail.c2: I-i^p+i^q ayingu-0. Bhala amaxabiso amabini ngqo.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.explain: I-i¹+i³=i+(−i)=0, i²+i⁸=−1+1=0, i¹⁰+i⁴=−1+1=0. Xa intsalela ye-p−q ehlulwe nge-4 ingu-2, amaxabiso amabini aziphikisi.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.prompt: Yitsho intsalela xa i-p−q yahlulwa nge-4 kwizibini oziyenzileyo, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni i-i^p+i^q ingu-0 ngoko, ngokukhupha i-i^q njengento ebalayo.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.hint.0: Kwizibini ezi-3 oziyenzileyo, fumana i-p−q, bhala intsalela nganye ekwahlulweni nge-4, uze ufumane oko zinako ngokufanayo.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala i-i^p njengemveliso ye-i^q ne-i^(p−q), uze usebenze ukuba i-i^(p−q) inaliphi ixabiso.

n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubale i-p−q ngqo kwizibini ezi-3 oziyenzileyo?

n-m-h1-eq-09.title: Ukuba akukho nanye kubaviwa beengcambu zenani eliphelele eyingcambu, ngaba akukho ngcambu yokwenyani nayo?
n-m-h1-eq-09.topic: Ukulingana kwamanqanaba aphezulu: ukuhlola abaviwa beengcambu zamanani aphelele nobukho beengcambu zokwenyani
n-m-h1-eq-09.goal: Hlukanisa oko isiphumo sokuhlola bonke abaviwa beengcambu zamanani aphelele sikuxelayo nesingakuxeliyo, uze ubonise ukuba ingcambu yokwenyani ikho usebenzisa ukutshintsha kophawu kumaxabiso emisebenzi.
n-m-h1-eq-09.material: UJiwon uzamile ukusombulula ukulingana f(x)=0 ye-f(x)=x³−3x−1. Ingcambu yenani eliphelele yokulingana kwee-coefficient zamanani aphelele ene-coefficient ephambili engu-1 ikuphakathi kwabahluli belungu elingatshintshiyo −1. UJiwon ufake abaviwa 1, −1 wahlola ukuba f(1)=−3 kunye ne-f(−1)=1 zombini azingu-0, waza waqukumbela “olu lingano alunazingcambu zokwenyani.” UDaeun uthe, “Ukuba ucinga ngegrafu yokulingana kwekyubhiki, isiphelo sikaJiwon sibonakala singaqhelekanga.”
n-m-h1-eq-09.thinking.1: Fumana ithuba apho uphawu lutshintsha khona
n-m-h1-eq-09.thinking.2: Chaza ukuba kutheni ikho ingcambu yokwenyani nangona kungekho ngcambu yenani eliphelele
n-m-h1-eq-09.prereq.0: Ithiyori yenxalenye yokwahlula kunye nabaviwa beengcambu zamanani aphelele (abahluli belungu elingatshintshiyo)
n-m-h1-eq-09.prereq.1: Ukubala amaxabiso emisebenzi nemo eqhubekayo yegrafu
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isigqibo esifaneleke kakhulu malunga novavanyo nesiphelo sikaJiwon.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuba isiphumo sokuhlola abaviwa beengcambu zamanani aphelele sithetha ngohlobo luni lwamanani.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuba ngaba uvavanyo luqulathe nasiphi na isiseko sokucima ukunokwenzeka kokuba elinye inani elingelo lenani eliphelele lanelisa i-f(x)=0.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.a: Kuchanekile: ukuba akukho nanye kubaviwa eyingcambu, akukho ngcambu yokwenyani nayo
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.r.a: Uthathe iingcambu zamanani aphelele neengcambu zokwenyani njengento enye. Cinga ukuba amanani athile okwenyani angelo manani aphelele angaba ziingcambu zokulingana na.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.b: Kuphosisiwe: ukuba abaviwa ±1 abayiyo iingcambu, kuthetha ukuba akukho ngcambu yenani eliphelele
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.r.c: f(1)=1−3−1=−3 kwaye f(−1)=−1+3−1=1, ngoko ukubala kuchanekile. Jonga ukuba ingxaki sisiphelo na, hayi ukubala.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.d: Akunakwaziwa: ithiyori yenxalenye yokwahlula ayinakusetyenziswa kokulingana kwekyubhiki
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.r.d: Ithiyori yenxalenye yokwahlula inokusetyenziswa neentetho zekyubhiki nazo. Ingxaki yile nto isixelela yona xa umviwa engeyiyo ingcambu.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.explain: Xa bonke abaviwa behlolwe, singathi kuphela “akukho ngcambu yenani eliphelele.” Kunokubakho ingcambu yokwenyani engelilo inani eliphelele, ngoko isiphelo esithi “akukho ngcambu zokwenyani” asixhaswa luvavanyo.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.prompt: Kwi-f(x)=x³−3x−1, fumana uze ufake izibini ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo (m, n) ezinjalo ukuba f(m)<0, f(n)>0, kwaye m no-n ngamanani aphelele ahluke nge-1 (−5≤m, n≤5).
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.hint.0: Bala i-f(m) ngolandelelwano ye-m ukusuka kwi-−5 ukuya kwi-5, ibhale kwitheyibhile, uze uphawule iimpawu kuphela.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.hint.1: Kwitheyibhile, fumana yonke indawo apho iseli elishumayo likufuphi neseli elikhutshayo.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.ok.c1: I-m ne-n zizinani eliphelele elilandelanayo elisebangeni.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.fail.c1: I-m ne-n kufuneka zibe zizinani eliphelele ukusuka kwi-−5 ukuya kwi-5 ezahluke nge-1.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.explain: f(−2)=−3, f(−1)=1, f(0)=−1, f(1)=−3, f(2)=1. Izibini ezisondeleneyo apho uphawu lutshintsha zi-(−2, −1), (0, −1), (1, 2).
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.prompt: Bhala ukuba kutheni, kwi-(m, n) apho f(m) no-f(n) banezimpawu ezichasayo, kukho ingcambu yeneneni ye-f(x)=0 phakathi kwazo, nokuba kutheni loo ngcambu yeneneni ihluke kubagqatswa abahlolwe nguJiwon.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.hint.0: Zoba igrafu ucinge ukuba, ukuba ayiwohli ngelixa isuka kwicala elinegethivu ukuya kwipozithivu, kufuneka ithwale i-eksisi ye-x.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ukuba iingcambu oyifumeneyo ilele phakathi kwamanani apheleleyo amabini ayiphi, uze uthelekise ukuba eli xabiso lingalingana no-±1.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale zombini ukuba uphawu lwexabiso lomsebenzi lutshintsha nokuba igrafu iqhagamshelwe?
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthe ingcambu yeneneni oyifumeneyo ilele phakathi kwamanani apheleleyo kwaye ayingabagqatswa ±1?
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.model.0: Igrafu ye-y=f(x) iqhagamshelwe ngaphandle kwamaqhekeza, ngoko ukuba f(m)<0 kwaye f(n)>0, ithwala i-eksisi ye-x phakathi kuka-m no-n. I-x kuloo ndawo yingcambu. Loo ngcambu linani eliphakathi kuka-m no-n, ngoko alilolo inani eliphelele, kwaye lahluke kubagqatswa 1, −1.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.model.1: Ekubeni igrafu ye-f iqhubekeka, ixabiso kufuneka libe ngu-0 ngaphakathi kwexesha apho litshintsha ukusuka kwinegethivu ukuya kwipozithivu. Le ngcambu ilele phakathi kwamanani apheleleyo amabini asondeleneyo, ngoko ayilolo inani eliphelele, kwaye ngoko ayinakufumaneka ngokuhlola abagqatswa beengcambu ezipheleleyo.

n-m-h1-logic-06.title: Ukubhala umyalezo wokuchaza "imeko efunekayo" kumzali omncinci

n-m-h1-logic-06.thinking.2: Ukubhala ngokutsha ngaphandle kweempawu kumphulaphuli othile

n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ngokutsha umgca ngamnye ngefom ethi "Ukuba □, ngoko □," usebenzisa iimpawu p no-q, uze uyithelekise nomthetho.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.hint.1: Chaza kwisivakalisi ukuba loluphi lolona lumeko lwelinye xa sithi "imeko efunekayo."
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.line.0: Umthetho uthi 'Ngaphandle kwekhadi lomfundi, awukwazi ukuboleka iincwadi.'
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.line.1: Ubhalwe nge-p no-q, lo mthetho yi-~p→~q.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.line.3: Ekubeni q→p iyinyani, p yimeko efunekayo ye-q.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.line.4: Ekubeni yimeko efunekayo, ukuba unekhadi lomfundi, unokuboleka iincwadi.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s1.explain: Ngumgca wesi-5. "p yimeko efunekayo ye-q" ithetha q→p, oko kukuthi ukuba unokuboleka iincwadi, unekhadi lomfundi. Ingxelo p→q, "ukuba unekhadi lomfundi, unokuboleka iincwadi," ayilandeli kumthetho. Umzekelo, usenokuba nekhadi lomfundi kodwa ungakwazi ukuboleka kuba incwadi iyawudlula ixesha. Imigca 1 ukuya kwesi-4 yonke ichanekile.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.prompt: Khetha umyalezo onokuncedisa uSubin kakhulu. (Sebenzisa umgangatho wokuncedisa uSubin alungise ngokwakhe, kunokuba umxelele nje impendulo.)
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.hint.0: Kumyalezo ngamnye, bhala emgceni omnye ukuba uSubin wayeya kwenza ntoni emva kokuwufumana.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuba umyalezo uyazamkela ngokuchanekileyo kwaye unika indlela yokuhlola eseleyo.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.o.a: Umgca wesi-5 uphosakele. Tshintsha "imeko efunekayo" ibe "yimeko eyaneleyo" uphinde wenze
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.r.a: Waxelela uSubin ukuba ngumgca muni oyiphosakeleyo, kodwa waphakamisa impazamo entsha, "imeko eyaneleyo." Ayinikeli ndlela yokuhlola ngokuzimeleyo.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.o.b: Yonke into ukuya kumgca wesi-4 ichanekile. Cinga ukuba ikho imeko apho unekhadi lomfundi kodwa usayibhalwa ukuboleka incwadi, uze ufunde ngokutsha umgca wesi-5
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.o.c: Iimeko ezifunekayo zidida ngenxa yecala, ngoko ukususela ngoku kungcono ukuhlala ukhumbula iimeko eziyaneleyo
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.r.c: Icebise ukuphepha ingcamango edidayo. Ayibonisanga ukuba sichanekile kangakanani esi sisombululo.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.o.d: Phinda ubale yonke into ukusuka kumgca woku-1 ukuya kowesi-4 ubhale ngokutsha yonke ukusuka ekuqaleni
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.r.d: Ibeke umthwalo kuSubin wokuphinda imigca eyayisele ichanekile. Ayizange ithi uhlole phi.
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s2.explain: Impendulo elungileyo iyazamkela ezichanekileyo kwaye inike indlela yokuhlola eseleyo ngokwakho. n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s3.prompt: Bhalela umzali wakho omncinci, okwibanga lesi-7, izivakalisi ezi-2 okanye ezi-3 ochaza ukuba kuthetha ntoni "ukuba nekhadi lomfundi yimeko efunekayo yokuboleka iincwadi," usebenzisa omnye umzekelo wemihla ngemihla. Musa ukusebenzisa iimpawu (p, q, →).
n-m-h1-logic-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala cinga ngemeko e-1 yemihla ngemihla apho kukho into ongenakuyenza ngaphandle kwayo, uyibhale.

n-m-h1-logic-05.title: Sifuna ukwazi ntoni enye ukuba siyazi kuphela ukuthi "Ukuba imvula iyana, kuyarhoxiswa"?
n-m-h1-logic-05.goal: Xa "ukuba p, ngoko q" iyinyaniso, fumana ukuba luluphi ulwazi olufunekayo ukuze kugqitywe ngokuqinisekileyo ukuba "ukuba q, ngoko p," uze uchaze usebenzisa i-contrapositive ukuba kutheni olo lwazi lwanele.
n-m-h1-logic-05.material: Umthetho wesikolo uthi, "Ukuba imvula iyana, ibanga elingaphandle lirhoxisiwe," yaye lo mthetho ulandelwa ngaphandle kokuhlukile. UMina ufuna ukuthi, ngalo lonke ixesha nangaphandle kokuhlukile, isigqibo esithi "Ukuba ibanga elingaphandle lirhoxisiwe, ngoko yayiyimini yemvula." Kumthetho, p ithi "Imvula iyana" kwaye q ithi "Ibanga elingaphandle lirhoxisiwe."
n-m-h1-logic-05.thinking.1: Ukuqonda ukuba isiphakamiso esijikisiweyo nesiphakamiso sokuchasa zinxulumene njani
n-m-h1-logic-05.prereq.0: Isiphakamiso esijikisiweyo, isiphakamiso sokuchasa, kunye ne-contrapositive yesiphakamiso p→q
n-m-h1-logic-05.prereq.1: I-contrapositive inexabiso lenyaniso elifanayo nesiphakamiso sokuqala
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha inyani, ngaphandle komthetho, efunekayo ukuze uqiniseke ngesigqibo sikaMina rhoqo.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubhale isigqibo uMina afuna ukusivakalisa ngendlela esithi "Ukuba □, ngoko □," usebenzisa p no-q.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.hint.1: Phinda ubhale ukhetho ngalunye ngendlela efanayo, uze unike isigqibo sokuba sele silandela emthethweni okanye lulwazi olutsha.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.o.a: Ngemihla apho ibanga elingaphandle liqhutywa, imvula ayinanga
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.r.a: Le ngxelo ichasene nomthetho othi "Ukuba kuyanetha, iklasi iyarhoxiswa." Sele ilandela emthethweni, ngoko ayilulwazi olutsha.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.o.b: Kwinyanga edlulileyo, usuku ngalunye olwarhoxiswa lwalunetha
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.r.b: Oko kubonwe amaxesha ambalwa okugqibela akuqinisekisi ukuba kuya kuhlala kunjalo kwixesha elizayo. Sidinga umthetho ohlala ubambe.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.o.d: Akukho ngaphezulu kweentsuku ezilishumi zokuthi kunethe kwinyanga
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.r.d: Inani leentsuku zemvula alinanto yakwenza no-"Ukuba yarhoxiswa, ngoko kwanetha."
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s1.explain: Isigqibo sikaMina yi-q→p (ukuphambana). "Ukuba akunethi, iklasi ayirhoxiswa" yi-~p→~q (ukuphosa), kwaye ukuphosa kwayo kuyi-q→p kanye. Ngoko ukuba ukuphosa kuhlala kubambe, ukuphambana kuhlala kubambe nako. Ukhetho a lukuphosa nje komthetho wokuqala kwaye alunikeli lwazi lutsha, kwaye b no-d azingomithetho ehlala ibambe okanye azinanxulumano.
n-m-h1-logic-05.s.s2.prompt: Usebenzisa inyaniso oyikhethileyo, chaza kwizivakalisi ezi-2 okanye ezi-3 ukuba kutheni isigqibo sikaMina sihlala sibambe. Sebenzisa igama elithi "ukuphosa."

n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.r.b: Ithathe esincinci phakathi kobungakanani beeseti zeziphindaphindo ezimbini njengobungakanani besidibanisi. Ayizange ifumane amanani adibanayo ngqo.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.o.c: Ziziphindaphindo zama-30, ngoko zikho ezi-2: 30 nama-60
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.r.d: Isebenzise u-3, umahluli oqhelekileyo wesi-6 nesi-15, njengesiseko. Ukuba siphindaphindo sesi-3 akwenzi inani libe siphindaphindo sesi-6 nesi-15.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.explain: Amanani angamasiphindaphindo ka-6 nesi-15 zombini ziziphindaphindo zesona siphindaphindo siqhelekileyo sincinci, ama-30. Ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kuma-60, zikho ezi-2: 30 nama-60. Ukuba uzibala njengeziphindaphindo zika-6×15=90, ufumana ngokungachanekanga akukho.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.prompt: Faka izibini ezi-2 ezahlukileyo zamanani endalo a, b ezinjalo ukuba n(A∪B)=12. Iimeko: 2≤a<b≤20, a no-b abangabalingani abangabahluli abaqhelekileyo, kwaye b asisiphindaphindo sika-a.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.hint.0: Kwi-a nganye, kuqala fumana n(A)=⌊60÷a⌋, uze uhlole ukuba ukongeza ubungakanani beeseti ezimbini nokuthabatha ukugqitha kunika i-12.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana ukugqitha usebenzisa isona siphindaphindo siqhelekileyo sincinci. Khetha ezimbalwa (a, b) ezinokwenzeka wenze itheyibhile yobalo ukuthelekisa.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b zizinani lendalo kunye ne-2≤a<b≤20.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Kufuneka zibe ngamanani endalo kunye ne-2≤a<b≤20.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Abangabalingani abangabahluli abaqhelekileyo, kwaye b asisiphindaphindo sika-a.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Akufuneki zibalingane abangabahluli abaqhelekileyo, kwaye b akufuneki ibe siphindaphindo sika-a.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.explain: (6, 15): 10+4−2=12, (6, 16): 10+3−1=12, (6, 20): 10+3−1=12, (8, 10): 7+6−1=12. Kolu luhlu, ezi zibini ezine kuphela. Ukuba ubala ukugqitha njengeziphindaphindo zika-a×b, ngoko (6, 15) inika i-10+4−0=14, ephosakeleyo.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Kwi-(a, b)=(6, 15), chaza ukuba kutheni akufanele ubale amalungu aqhelekileyo njengeziphindaphindo zika-6×15=90.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala iziphindaphindo zesi-6 nezesi-15 ukuya kuma-60 ufumane amanani abelana ngawo.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba la manani mancinci okanye makhulu kuma-90.

n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthe ama-90 lelinye nje lamasiphindaphindo aqhelekileyo, hayi elincinci?
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Isona siphindaphindo siqhelekileyo sincinci sesi-6 nesi-15 ngama-30. Ngoko 30 nama-60 ziziphindaphindo zazo zombini nazo, kwaye ukuba ubala kuphela iziphindaphindo zama-90, uyazishiya ezi zimbini uze ufumane ngokungachanekanga.

n-m-h1-logic-08.title: Siwagqiba njani amabango athi "kuwo onke x" ayinyani okanye ayinyani?
n-m-h1-logic-08.goal: Gqiba ukuba isindululo esiqala ngo-"kuwo onke x" siyinyani okanye asiyiyo usebenzisa umzekelo ochasayo omnye okanye ingxoxo epheleleyo, hayi amaxabiso ambalwa; bhala ukuphikisa kwaso ngokuchanekileyo; uze uqwalasele amaxabiso omda.
n-m-h1-logic-08.material:
Isindululo P: "Kuwo onke amanani eneneni x, x²−4x+k>0." (k ngumthamo ongatshintshiyo) Abahlobo abathathu bagqiba ukuba P iyinyani okanye asiyiyo xa k=4, ngolu hlobo.
- Jiho: Ndifake x=0, 1, 3, 5 kwaye onke amaxabiso ayekhulu kune-0, ngoko iyinyani.
- Seoyeon: x²−4x+4=(x−2)², kwaye isikwere si-0 ubuncinane, ngoko ihlala inkulu kune-0. Iyinyani.
- Daeun: Ukuba ndifaka x=2, ixabiso li-0, elingekhulu kune-0. Ayiyiyo inyani.
n-m-h1-logic-08.thinking.0: Ukwahlula amaxabiso ambalwa owahlolileyo kuwo onke amaxabiso
n-m-h1-logic-08.thinking.2: Ukugqiba ukuba amaxabiso omda abandakanywa na
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.prompt: Xa k=4, khetha ixabiso lenyaniso elichanekileyo le-P kunye nesizathu sayo esichanekileyo.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.hint.0: Wahlula ukuba ingqiqo yomhlobo ngamnye "yahlola amaxabiso ambalwa" okanye "yagubungela onke amaxabiso."
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana ixabiso elincinci lebinzana elabhalwa nguSeoyeon, uze ulithelekise no-"inkulu kune-0."
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.a: Iyinyani: kuba yabamba kuwo onke amaxabiso ambalwa endiwazamileyo
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.r.a: Itshintshe "onke amanani eneneni" ngamaxabiso ambalwa ahlolwe. Kusekho amaxabiso angahlolwanga.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.b: Iyinyani: isikwere si-0 ubuncinane ngamaxesha onke, ngoko ixabiso lebinzana likhulu kune-0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.r.b: Itshintshe "ubuncinane li-0" yaba "likhulu kune-0." Ishiye imeko apho ukulingana kubambe khona.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.c: Ayiyiyo inyani: kukho inani leneneni apho ibinzana lilingana no-0, nto leyo ephula "enkulu kune-0 kuwo onke amanani eneneni"
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.d: Akunakwaziwa: kukho amanani eneneni angapheliyo, ngoko akunakwenzeka ukuwahlola onke
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.r.d: Icinge ukuba unokugqiba kuphela ngokuhlola amaxabiso omnye ngomnye. Unokugqiba usebenzisa umzekelo ochasayo omnye okanye isakhiwo sebinzana.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.explain: Isindululo sefom ethi "kuwo onke amanani eneneni x" asiyiyo inyani ukuba nokuba x e-1 (umzekelo ochasayo) iyasilela. Xa k=4, ibinzana li-(x−2)², kwaye kwi-x=2 li-0, ngoko "enkulu kune-0" ayibambi; ngoko P asiyiyo inyani. Indlela kaJiho yamaxabiso ambalwa ahloliweyo kuphela, kwaye uSeoyeon waxuba "ubuncinane li-0" no-"enkulu kune-0."
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ukuba mangaphi amaxabiso e-x afuneka asilele ukuze "kuwo onke …, …" ingabi yinyani.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuba ukuphikisa kokungalingani ">" yintoni, nokuba imeko elingana no-0 iya kweliphi icala.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.a: Kuwo onke amanani eneneni x, x²−4x+k<0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.r.a: Igcine "kuwo onke" njengoko injalo, kwaye ibhale nokuphikisa kwe-">" njenge-"<" kuphela. Zombini iinxalenye ziphosakele.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.b: Kuwo onke amanani eneneni x, x²−4x+k≤0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.r.b: Igcine "kuwo onke" njengokuphikisa kwe-"kuwo onke" yatshintsha uphawu lokungalingani kuphela emva koko. Ishiye ukuba ingxelo ayiyonyani kwangoko nje xa nemeko e-1 isilela.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.c: Kukho inani leneneni x elinjalo ukuba x²−4x+k<0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.r.c: Ibhale ukuphikisa kwe-">" njenge-"<" kuphela. Imeko apho ixabiso li-0 ilahlekile.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.d: Kukho inani leneneni x elinjalo ukuba x²−4x+k≤0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.explain: Ukuphikisa kwe-"kuwo onke x, A" yi-"kukho x enjalo ukuba kungenjalo A." Ukuphikisa kwe->0 yi-≤0 (ubuninzi li-0), ngoko ukuphikisa kuthi: kukho inani leneneni x elinjalo ukuba x²−4x+k≤0. Xa k=4, oku kuphikisa kuyinyani kwi-x=2, nto leyo ehambelana negwebo lokuba P asiyiyo inyani.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.prompt: Bhala uluhlu lwamaxabiso ka-k apho P iyinyani, uze uchaze kwisivakalisi esi-1 ukuba kutheni k=4 ingekho kolo luhlu.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ngokutsha x²−4x+k ngefom apho (x−2)² ibonakala khona, uze uchaze ixabiso elincinci ngokwe-k.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa nemeko ethi ">0" ukugqiba ukuba eli xabiso lincinci kufuneka libe likhulu kune-0 okanye li-0 ubuncinane kuphela.

n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ugqibe uluhlu usebenzisa into yokuba ixabiso elincinci kufuneka libe likhulu kune-0?
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ubonise ngexabiso le-x ukuba kutheni ">" isilela kwixabiso lomda?
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.model.0: x²−4x+k=(x−2)²+k−4 kwaye ubuncinane yi-k−4, ngoko ihlala inkulu kune-0 xa k>4. Ukuba k=4, ixabiso li-0 kwi-x=2, ngoko alikhulu kune-0 kwaye k=4 ayibandakanywa.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.model.1: I-discriminant 16−4k kufuneka ibe negethivu, ngoko k kufuneka ibe nkulu kune-4. Ukuba k=4, i-discriminant ingu-0, ngoko ixabiso lebinzana li-0 kwi-x=2, kwaye P asiyiyo inyani.
